styles.summary: 物体各部位朝同一方向移动，起步和停下的时刻略有错开。

Start the leading part first and delay each following part by 0.07 seconds. Set each part's duration to 1.1 seconds, increasing it by 0.06 seconds for each successive part so it stops later. Use power3.inOut and hold for 0.6 seconds after arrival. Animate transforms only and use a single paused timeline that supports seeking.

styles.name: 缓动曲线
styles.summary: 移动距离和时长不变，途中速度逐渐变化。
styles.prompt: Arrange {script} in three rows with GSAP to compare a 670px movement to the right. Start all three at 0.30 seconds and animate for 1.50 seconds using none, power3.in, and power3.out respectively. Make only the last row vermilion. Show small easing graphs at 1.90 seconds and hold until 3.00 seconds.

styles.name: 弹簧回弹
styles.summary: 物体先超过目标大小，再回到原位停稳。
styles.prompt: Represent {script} as an ink-black block and animate scale from 0 to 1 with back.out(1.5), starting at 0.3 seconds over 1.4 seconds. The maximum scale is 1.08. Update the adjacent time graph and scale readout from the same proxy value. Draw only the graph segment above 1.00 in vermilion, and hold the completed state from 2.05 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 挤压拉伸
styles.summary: 加速时拉长、碰撞时压扁，同时保持体量感。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to drop the {script} ball 340px starting at 0.30 seconds over 0.85 seconds. Stretch its vertical scale to 1.55 over 0.55 seconds, then squash it to 0.55 over 0.10 seconds starting at the 1.15-second impact. Always set horizontal scale to the reciprocal of vertical scale and use the bottom as the transform origin. Starting at 1.36 seconds, bounce it 210px upward, then return it to a circular shape on the floor by 2.46 seconds. Hold until 3.00 seconds.

styles.name: 依次入场
styles.summary: 多个元素隔着相同时间依次出现。
styles.prompt: Arrange {script} as 12 ink-black blocks in 4 columns and 3 rows and add a stagger. Start at 0.3 seconds. Animate each element from y 24px to 0px and opacity 0 to 1 over 0.55 seconds with power3.out and a 0.06-second stagger. Keep sequence numbers fixed below each cell, make only the last cell vermilion, and hold the completed state from 1.85 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 弧线运动
styles.summary: 物体沿弯曲轨迹移动。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to move the {script} dot 770px to the right starting at 0.30 seconds over 1.65 seconds, following a parabola with a peak height of 230px. For progress p, calculate x=770*p and y=-4*230*p*(1-p). Leave gray trajectory dots behind after passing them, spaced at 0.025 progress intervals. Above it, show a gray straight-line comparison with the same timing. Hold the arrival state from 2.35 to 3.00 seconds.

styles.name: 动作混合
styles.summary: 两种动作按比例混合，平滑接到下一段。
styles.prompt: Add a motion blend to {script} from <motion A> to <motion B> with GSAP. From 0.9s over 0.3s raise a weight v from 0 to 1 linearly and compute each property as A*(1-v)+B*v. Ease none, weights always sum to 1. Seeking on the paused timeline must give identical values.

styles.name: 拖影帧
styles.summary: 快速移动时沿前进方向拉长，随后恢复形状。
styles.prompt: Add a smear frame to {script} as it moves 900px in x over 0.12s. At 0.4s move with power4.in, and in the same moment stretch scaleX to 1.8 over 0.06s with transformOrigin 100% 50%, then return to 1 over 0.1s from 0.52s. Stretch only along the travel axis. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 动作接力
styles.summary: 前一个动作结束后再开始下一个，逐步展示过程。
styles.prompt: Reveal the steps .s1, .s2 and .s3 of {script} in order with GSAP. Start at 0.3s. Each step animates from opacity 0, y +24px over 0.7s with power2.out, and the next starts 0.12s after the previous ends. Hold 0.6s after the last. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 叠加动作
styles.summary: 主体沿大路径移动时，叠上小幅晃动或旋转。
styles.prompt: Add additive motion to the card in {script}. The parent .rig moves x 900px over 2 seconds with power2.inOut, while the child .item adds y 6px and 2 degrees of rotation with sine.inOut, yoyo half-periods of 0.2s, 10 times. Use separate tweens so neither overwrites the other.

styles.name: 节拍同步
styles.summary: 到达、缩放和切镜恰好落在音乐拍点上。
styles.prompt: Build a GSAP timeline where 4 cards of {script} land on the beat of a 100 BPM track. The beat interval is 0.6 seconds and card i arrives at (i+1)*0.6s. Each card rises from 60px below over 0.4 seconds with power3.out, and its start time is arrival minus 0.4s.

styles.name: 落地弹跳
styles.summary: 物体加速落下，反弹高度逐次降低，最后停住。
styles.prompt: Make the icon in {script} drop from 120px above and bounce three times over 1 second with bounce.out. Animate the contact shadow at the same time, scale 0.6 to 1 and opacity 0.2 to 0.5. Start at 0.3 seconds.

styles.name: 同时运动
styles.summary: 多个对象或属性在同一段时间里一起变化。
styles.prompt: Make .left, .right and .gauge of {script} move at exactly the same time with GSAP. Start 0.3s, duration 0.9s, ease power2.inOut for all; .left height 120px, .right 360px, .gauge rotation 60 degrees. Use the same position so starts do not drift. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 连续运动
styles.summary: 元素穿过多个位置或场景，中途不停顿。
styles.prompt: Make the marker in {script} pass three stops (x 300, 900, 1500) without stopping. Use a single GSAP keyframes tween of 1.8 seconds with ease none, adding a short ease only at the very start and end (sine.inOut, 0.3s). Do not set an ease per segment.

styles.name: 成组移动
styles.summary: 同组元素按相同方向和速度移动，像一个整体。
styles.prompt: Move the {script} dot groups as units with GSAP. Move all .grp-a dots x +240px at 0.3s over 0.7s with power2.inOut at the same moment, then .grp-b x -180px 0.16s later the same way. No stagger inside a group. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 惯性滑行
styles.summary: 松手后物体继续前进，逐渐减速停下。
styles.prompt: Add inertial glide to the card in {script}. Use an initial velocity of 600px/s and a time constant of 0.7 seconds for exponential decay, traveling about 420px over 2 seconds and stopping. Approximate with ease expo.out in GSAP and start at 0.3 seconds.

styles.name: 途中改向
styles.summary: 目标中途改变时，元素从当前位置缓缓转向。
styles.prompt: In {script}, make a dot move to x 700 over 0.8 seconds with power2.out, then at 0.52 seconds retarget it to x 200. Continue from its current position over 0.4 seconds with power2.out and no jump back to the start.

styles.name: 绕轴旋转
styles.summary: 元素绕中心点转动，改变朝向。
styles.prompt: Rotate the {script} arrow icon with GSAP. From 0.4s over 0.3s rotate 0 to 90 degrees around 50% 50% with power2.out. Use absolute angles and do not rotate text. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 等比缩放
styles.summary: 元素从锚点向外长大或向内缩小。
styles.prompt: Add a scale entrance to {script} with GSAP. At 0.3s start at scale 0.96, opacity 0 and grow to scale 1, opacity 1 over 0.3s with power3.out. transformOrigin 50% 50%, or 50% 100% for bars. End scale exactly 1 and use a paused timeline.

styles.name: 状态渐变
styles.summary: 位置、大小、角度和颜色一起过渡到下一状态。
styles.prompt: Add a state tween to {script} with GSAP. From 0.3s over 0.8s change x 0 to 420px, scale 1 to 1.3, rotation 0 to 15 degrees and backgroundColor #2f6bff to #ffc83d together with power2.inOut, with the start state written in fromTo. Hold 0.6s after arrival. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 逐步跳变
styles.summary: 数值或姿势一格格直接切换，没有中间过渡。
styles.prompt: Move the element in {script} in 8 snapped steps instead of a smooth glide. Go from x 0 to 160px over 0.8 seconds with GSAP ease steps(8), so it jumps 20px every 100ms. Start at 0.3 seconds.

styles.name: 时间重叠
styles.summary: 前一个元素没停下，下一个就开始动，形成波浪。
styles.prompt: Have cards .c1, .c2 and .c3 of {script} enter with overlap in GSAP. Each animates from opacity 0, y +40px over 0.6s with power3.out, and the next starts 0.15s before the previous ends. Start at 0.3s. Compute positions on one paused timeline.

styles.name: 对称面板展开
styles.summary: 两块面板从相反方向进入，转向同一个正面。
styles.prompt: Implement Symmetric Panel Open for {script} in <file>. Two panels enter from opposite sides and rotate toward a shared frontal plane. Use entrance duration: 600ms; entrance distance: 240px; Y rotation: 15deg; badge delay: 300ms; easing: power2.out in a single paused GSAP core timeline that supports seeking. Keep panel text readable through the perspective change.

styles.name: 缩小淡入
styles.summary: 小而半透明的元素移入，恢复完整大小和不透明度。
styles.prompt: Apply Back Entrance to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, travel distance 1200px, initial scale 0.7, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 百叶条展开
styles.summary: 错开的条带依次打开，拼成完整图像。
styles.prompt: Apply Blinds Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.4s segment with power3.out; implement these explicit settings: Strip count: 6, Strip delay: 0.05s. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 模糊显现
styles.summary: 模糊文字或图像逐渐变得清晰。
styles.prompt: Apply Blur Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.6s segment with power2.out; implement these explicit settings: Initial blur: 12px, Initial opacity: 0. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 模糊滑入
styles.summary: 拉长模糊的元素滑到位置后恢复正常形状。
styles.prompt: Apply Blurred Slide to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 600ms duration, travel distance 800px, initial blur 30px, horizontal scale 2, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 模糊甩出
styles.summary: 元素向侧面倾斜移走，最后融进浓重模糊中。
styles.prompt: Apply Bomb Exit to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, rotation 160deg, horizontal travel 200px, final blur 50px, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 角点遮罩摆开
styles.summary: 不透明盖板绕角点旋转，露出下面内容。
styles.prompt: Apply Corner Mask Swing to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.6s segment with power3.out; implement these explicit settings: Rotation: 90deg, Transform origin: 0% 0%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 反向遮罩移动
styles.summary: 揭示窗口和窗口里的内容向相反方向移动。
styles.prompt: Apply Counter Moving Matte to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.6s segment with power3.out; implement these explicit settings: Initial window translation: 100%, Initial content translation: -30%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 幕帘揭示
styles.summary: 前景物体向两侧分开，露出后方标题。
styles.prompt: Apply Curtain Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.2s segment with power3.inOut; implement these explicit settings: Horizontal travel per side: 600px, Layer delay: 0.08s. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 像素块还原
styles.summary: 大块像素逐渐还原成清晰图像。
styles.prompt: Apply Depixelate Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.2s segment with power2.out; implement these explicit settings: Initial block size: 32px, Final block size: 1px. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 椭圆轨迹入场
styles.summary: 倾斜缩放的元素沿弧形轨迹进入，最后转正。
styles.prompt: Apply Elliptic Entrance to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, horizontal travel 500px, initial rotation 60deg, initial scale 0.1, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 滑动淡入
styles.summary: 元素一边滑向目标位置，一边变得可见。
styles.prompt: Apply Fade Slide to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.5s segment with power2.out; implement these explicit settings: Vertical travel: 24px, Initial opacity: 0. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 淡入淡出
styles.summary: 元素留在原位，只靠透明度出现或消失。
styles.prompt: Apply Fade to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 600ms duration, initial opacity 0, final opacity 1, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 闪烁显现
styles.summary: 元素不规则地闪灭几次，最后保持可见。
styles.prompt: Apply Flicker Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1200ms duration, flickers 6, opacity 0 or 1, easing steps(1, end). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 翻面显现
styles.summary: 侧对观众的元素绕三维轴翻到正面。
styles.prompt: Apply Flip Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, perspective 800px, initial rotation 90deg, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 绕角弹入
styles.summary: 元素边放大边轮流绕不同角点旋转。
styles.prompt: Apply Foolish Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, total rotation 360deg, pivot four corners, initial scale 0, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 铰链坠落
styles.summary: 元素先挂在角点上晃动，再掉出画面。
styles.prompt: Apply Hinge Drop to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1600ms duration, maximum rotation 70deg, drop distance 700px, swings 3, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 铰链翻开
styles.summary: 面板绕边缘转动，逐渐面向观众。
styles.prompt: Apply Hinge Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.65s segment with power3.out; implement these explicit settings: Initial angle: 90deg, Perspective: 800px, Transform origin: 0% 50%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 盒中弹出
styles.summary: 元素从小而歪的状态弹出，左右摆动后停稳。
styles.prompt: Apply Jack in the Box to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, initial scale 0.1, initial rotation 30deg, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 高速斜冲
styles.summary: 元素从侧面快速冲入，先倾斜再反向轻摆归正。
styles.prompt: Apply Light Speed to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, travel distance 100%, initial skew 30deg, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 旋转放大退场
styles.summary: 元素边放大边绕偏心轴旋转，离开画面。
styles.prompt: Apply Magic Exit to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, rotation 270deg, final scale 2, travel distance 100%, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 马赛克窗口揭示
styles.summary: 小方格窗口依次打开，露出完整图像。
styles.prompt: Apply Mosaic Reveal to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.6s segment with power2.out; implement these explicit settings: Tile grid: 6x4, Tile delay: 0.04s, Tile duration: 0.68s. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 加速退场
styles.summary: 元素一边旋转或下落，一边加速离开屏幕。
styles.prompt: Apply Physical Exit to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.5s segment with power2.in; implement these explicit settings: Exit distance: 1200px, Rotation: 12deg. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 膨胀模糊显隐
styles.summary: 放大模糊的元素缩回清晰状态，或反向消散。
styles.prompt: Apply Puff Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, initial scale 2, initial blur 12px, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 滚动入场
styles.summary: 元素边横向移动边在画面内旋转滚入。
styles.prompt: Apply Roll Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, travel distance 100%, initial rotation -120deg, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 旋转显隐
styles.summary: 元素在平面内旋转，同时出现或消失。
styles.prompt: Apply Rotate Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 600ms duration, initial rotation -90deg, pivot 50% 50%, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 缩放弹出
styles.summary: 元素从很小的尺寸长到最终大小。
styles.prompt: Apply Scale Pop to {script} in <file>. Use a 0.5s segment with power3.out; implement these explicit settings: Initial scale: 0, Transform origin: 50% 50%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and hold the final pose.

styles.name: 边缘滑入
styles.summary: 元素从画面边缘滑进来，或滑出去。
styles.prompt: Apply Slide to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 600ms duration, travel distance 100%, direction left, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 绕行换位入场
styles.summary: 画外的大元素绕过来，再缩小到目标位置。
styles.prompt: Apply Swap Entrance to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1000ms duration, initial scale 3, horizontal travel 700px, initial rotation -30deg, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 旋涡显现
styles.summary: 元素一边转好几圈，一边缩放进入画面。
styles.prompt: Apply Swirl Reveal to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 700ms duration, initial rotation -540deg, initial scale 0, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 倾斜入场
styles.summary: 元素斜着进入，落位时逐渐消除旋转和歪斜。
styles.prompt: Apply Tilt Entrance to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 650ms duration, initial rotation 30deg, initial skew 15deg, vertical travel 80px, easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Preserve the final state and show it immediately when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 模糊聚焦
styles.summary: 目标的模糊半径不断减小，视线集中到清晰处。
styles.prompt: Add a blur resolve to the {script} title with GSAP. At 0.3s start with filter blur(4px), opacity 0 and animate to blur(0px), opacity 1 over 0.25s with power2.out. Use clearProps to remove filter afterward so text stays sharp. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 裁切展开
styles.summary: 边界内的可见区域从一侧逐渐展开。
styles.prompt: Add a clip reveal to the {script} image with GSAP. From 0.3s over 0.35s open clipPath from inset(100% 0% 0% 0%) to inset(0% 0% 0% 0%) with power3.out, revealing upward. Put the same initial value in CSS to avoid a first-frame flash. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 瞬间出现
styles.summary: 元素在指定时刻直接出现。
styles.prompt: Implement Hard Appearance on {script}. Use transition duration 0ms; hold duration 800ms; appearance time 400ms; final opacity 1; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 亮边显现
styles.summary: 明亮轮廓描出主体，内部逐渐变清晰。
styles.prompt: Implement Outline Flash Reveal on {script}. Use duration 900ms; stroke width 2px; fill delay 120ms; final fill opacity 1; use power2.out easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 碎纸退场
styles.summary: 纸张送入狭缝，被切成窄条向下掉落。
styles.prompt: Implement Paper Shred Exit on {script}. Use duration 2s; feed speed 180px/s; strip width 10px; fall distance 140px; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 螺旋拼合
styles.summary: 碎片沿螺旋向内聚拢，在最终位置停住。
styles.prompt: Implement Spiral Assembly on {script}. Use duration 1.5s; rotation 540deg; initial radius 300px; piece stagger 0.04s; use power2.out easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 字母旋入
styles.summary: 字母歪着或转着进入，再排成正向文字。
styles.prompt: Make each syllable of the title in {script} rotate in from 90deg and 24px below, landing upright over 0.7s power3.out. Stagger syllables 0.035s, keep transform-origin at center and display inline-block. Finish within 1.2s.

styles.name: 卡片包围
styles.summary: 静止主体周围的卡片越来越快地涌入。
styles.prompt: Apply Overwhelm Surround to {script} in <file>. Place twelve cards on a 600px by 360px elliptical orbit and normalize arrival gaps with a 600ms to 150ms ratio to a 2500ms schedule. Define the initial state and use a paused timeline with fixed coordinates and timings for repeatable seeking.

styles.name: 阈值脉冲
styles.summary: 计数达到警戒值时变得更醒目，并短暂放大。
styles.prompt: Implement Threshold Pulse for {script} in <file>. A counter becomes more prominent and briefly scales up when it reaches a warning threshold. Use warning threshold: 20%; peak scale: 1.12; pulse duration: 200ms; easing: power2.out in a single paused GSAP core timeline that supports seeking. Use a warning label as well as color.

styles.name: 边框合围
styles.summary: 边框线从元素外侧收拢，描出轮廓。
styles.prompt: Add a border reveal to {script} with GSAP. At 0.4s start with a 2px outline, outlineOffset 8px, alpha 0 and animate to offset 0, alpha 1 over 0.35s with power2.out. Use <color> with at least 3:1 contrast against the background, and use outline so layout does not shift.

styles.name: 果冻扭动
styles.summary: 元素交替歪斜，晃动幅度逐渐减小。
styles.prompt: Add a jello to the {script} card with GSAP. From 0.3s, every 0.18s set skewX to 12, -6, 3, -1.5, 0 degrees with skewY at -0.5x of that. Ease sine.inOut and stop within 0.9s. Drop the amplitude to 6 degrees if the card has text. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 轻微脉冲
styles.summary: 元素在原位短暂放大，再回到原尺寸。
styles.prompt: Add a pulse to {script} with GSAP. Start at 0.4s, scale from 1 to 1.05 over 0.5s and back, repeated 3 times. Ease sine.inOut, then hold at the original size. Use transforms only, on a paused timeline so it can be seeked.

styles.name: 旋转缩放
styles.summary: 元素边转边变大，最后回到原来的大小。
styles.prompt: Add a rotate-scale to the {script} icon with GSAP. From 0.3s for 0.45s, rotation -360 to 0 and scale 0.7 to 1.2 with power3.out, then scale 1.2 to 1 over 0.25s with power2.inOut. Pivot at 50% 50% and use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 庆祝摇摆
styles.summary: 元素先缩后放，左右轻摇几下再停住。
styles.prompt: Add a tada to the {script} badge with GSAP. At 0.3s scale to 0.9 over 0.1s, then to 1.1 while rotating +3, -3, +3, -3 degrees at 0.1s each, and return to scale 1, rotation 0 over 0.3s. Never exceed 5 degrees. Use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 左右摇晃
styles.summary: 元素带着倾斜左右摆动，幅度逐渐缩小。
styles.prompt: Add a wobble to {script} with GSAP. From 0.3s, every 0.17s set xPercent to -25, 20, -15, 10, -5, 0 and rotate opposite to the shift by 0.2x the amplitude (max 5 degrees). Ease power2.out, keep the array fixed in code, and use a paused timeline.

styles.name: 随声脉冲
styles.summary: 图形大小与发光强度跟着声音频段强弱变化。
styles.prompt: Make the logo in {script} react to bass. Read a pre-extracted bass.json (30fps, values 0 to 1) and set scale to 1+amp*0.04 and glow opacity to 0.4+amp*0.3 every frame. Do not analyze audio at playback; index the array with timeline time().

styles.name: 明暗闪烁
styles.summary: 元素的亮度或透明度反复开关。
styles.prompt: Add a blink to the status dot in {script}. From 0.3 seconds animate opacity 1 to 0 over 0.25s with sine.inOut, yoyo and repeat 3, for 1 second and 2 blinks total, ending at opacity 1. Stay under 3 blinks per second.

styles.name: 原地弹跳
styles.summary: 元素在原地上下弹跳，再回到原位置。
styles.prompt: Add an attention bounce to the button in {script}. From 0.3 seconds bounce three times with heights 24px, 13px and 7px, each rise 0.12s power2.out and each fall 0.12s power2.in, ending exactly at y 0.

styles.name: 圈框强调
styles.summary: 圆圈或方框沿目标画出，随后擦掉。
styles.prompt: Add a circumscribe around {script} with GSAP. A rectangle 12px outside the bbox with stroke 3px starts at 0.4s and draws strokeDashoffset 1 to 0 over 0.6s, then fades to opacity 0 over 0.3s at 1.4s. pathLength=1, color <accent>. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 颜色渐变
styles.summary: 元素颜色从当前色平滑变成下一种颜色。
styles.prompt: Add a color transition to the {script} bar with GSAP. From 0.4s over 0.45s change backgroundColor from #2f6bff to #ffc83d with sine.inOut, and change the label text color to #7a5a00 at the same time. Do not rely on color alone, so include a state phrase in the label. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 圆盘收聚
styles.summary: 宽大的半透明圆盘向目标收缩，随后消失。
styles.prompt: Add a focus contraction at {script} with GSAP. From 0.4s over 0.7s shrink a disk (cx, cy at <coordinates>) from radius 400 to 0 and opacity 0.25 to 0 with power2.out. Disk color <accent>. No repeat, on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 焦点接力
styles.summary: 已排好的元素逐个亮起，重点移向下一项。
styles.prompt: Make all 4 list items in {script} visible from the start at 0.35 opacity, then from 0.4 seconds light them one at a time with opacity 1 and scale 1.04. Each holds 500ms then hands off over 150ms while the previous returns to 0.35. Use power2.inOut.

styles.name: 轮廓脉冲
styles.summary: 边线短暂变粗变亮，再恢复原状。
styles.prompt: Add an outline pulse to the {script} outline path with GSAP. From 0.4s over 0.7s raise stroke-width 1 to 3px and strokeOpacity 0 to 0.8 with sine.inOut, then return to 1px and 0 in the same time. Color <accent>, at least 3:1 against the background. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 放射速度线
styles.summary: 线条从中心向外短暂爆开，再消失。
styles.prompt: Add radial speed lines when the title in {script} appears. Use 16 SVG lines extending from radius 60px to 400px over 0.3 seconds with power2.out while opacity goes from 1 to 0. Start at 0.5 seconds with the title; lines are 3px white.

styles.name: 选区移动
styles.summary: 半透明选区带移向下一范围，并调整大小。
styles.prompt: Move a translucent selection band over {script} code with GSAP. Reuse one band at opacity 0.25 and, from 0.3s every 1.2s, tween y and height to the next entry of spans [{y:120,h:36},{y:300,h:108},{y:516,h:36}] over 0.4s with power3.inOut. Hold 0.8s per range. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 短促抖动
styles.summary: 元素在原位置或角度两侧来回抖几下。
styles.prompt: Add a shake to the input field in {script}. Move x through 6, -3.6, 2.2, -1.3, 0px in 0.12-second sine.inOut steps for a damped 0.6-second oscillation starting at 0.5 seconds. End at exactly x 0.

styles.name: 悬挂摆动
styles.summary: 元素绕固定悬点左右转动，摆幅逐渐减小。
styles.prompt: Add a swing to the card in {script}. Set transformOrigin to top left and step rotation 6, -3.6, 2, 0 degrees over 0.55 seconds, each segment power2.inOut and the last power2.out. Start at 0.3 seconds right after the entrance finishes.

styles.name: 暗角脉冲
styles.summary: 画面周围的暗边短暂向内收紧，再放开。
styles.prompt: Add a vignette pulse to the scene in {script}. Put a full overlay with radial-gradient(transparent 55%, #000 100%) and at 1.2 seconds tighten it to opacity 0.4 and scale 0.9 over 0.1 seconds, then release over 0.12 seconds back to 0.

styles.name: 文字扫色
styles.summary: 亮色从一侧扫过，覆盖原来的暗色文字。
styles.prompt: Fill the sentence in {script} with a color wipe. Overlay a white copy of the same font and size over a dim gray copy (opacity 0.3) and animate clip-path from inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0% 0 0) over 2 seconds with ease none, softening the edge by about 200ms. For multiple lines, fill line by line in order.

styles.name: 字母掉落堆积
styles.summary: 句子中的字母脱落，落地后堆成一堆。
styles.prompt: Drop the phrase '{script}' in {script} letter by letter (per syllable for Korean). 0.06 seconds apart, each falls from -600px to the floor in 0.9 seconds with bounce.out and lands tilted between 10 and 30 degrees by index. No random values, use deterministic formulas. Hold 1 second after the last letter lands.

styles.name: 逐字上升
styles.summary: 字符隔着时间差，从下方向上淡入。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Split "AI picks the next word" into individual spans while preserving spaces. Starting at 0.30 seconds, stagger characters by 0.035 seconds and animate from y 64px and opacity 0 to y 0 and opacity 1 over 0.62 seconds with power3.out. Within a 3-second timeline, hold the completed state for the final 0.6 seconds.

styles.name: 荧光笔扫过
styles.summary: 高亮色带从左向右扫过关键词背后。
styles.prompt: Add a highlight sweep behind "next word" in the sentence in {script}. Keep the text at 84px. Place a pale vermilion band with height 66px, horizontal padding 8px, and transform-origin 0 50%. Starting at 0.3 seconds, animate scaleX from 0 to 1 over 1.35 seconds with power1.inOut, and hold until 3 seconds.

styles.name: 大字踩拍
styles.summary: 大字按节拍冲到画面中心，很快停稳。
styles.prompt: Show the three words "Read", "Score", and "Pick" one at a time in the center of {script}. At 0.3, 0.8, and 1.3 seconds, make each word hit with opacity 1 and scale 1.4, then settle to scale 1 over 0.25 seconds with power3.out. Immediately hide the previous word on the next beat. Keep only the final word "Pick" in vermilion until 3 seconds.

styles.name: 分行遮罩揭示
styles.summary: 标题向上进入裁切窗口，一行行露出来。
styles.prompt: Apply a mask reveal to the two-line title in {script}. Place each line inside a 116px-high overflow hidden window. Starting at 0.3 seconds, animate the inner text from yPercent 110 to 0 over 1.05 seconds with power3.out. Start the second line 0.35 seconds later and hold the completed state until 3 seconds.

styles.name: 乱码解码
styles.summary: 各个字位轮流跳符号，再从左到右变成最终文字。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Fix each character slot in "AI picks the next word" to its original text width and preserve spaces. Precompute a symbol table with Motion.rand(603), cycle symbols at 0.05-second intervals starting at 0.30 seconds, and lock characters to the final text from left to right at 0.085-second intervals starting at 0.70 seconds. Within a 3-second timeline, hold the completed state for the final 0.6 seconds.

styles.name: 打字机
styles.summary: 句子按固定间隔逐字出现，光标跟着向前走。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Split "AI picks the next word" into character spans and reveal each instantly at 0.06-second intervals starting at 0.30 seconds. Make a vermilion cursor follow the end of the input and blink at 0.24-second intervals, then remain on from 2.4 seconds. Within a 3-second timeline, hold the completed state for the final 0.6 seconds.

styles.name: 下划线绘制
styles.summary: 一笔从左向右在关键词下方画线。
styles.prompt: Draw a vermilion SVG underline beneath "next word" in {script} in a single stroke. Use pathLength 1, stroke-dasharray 1, a 6px stroke, rounded caps, and a slightly curved path. Starting at 0.3 seconds, animate strokeDashoffset from 1 to 0 over 1.35 seconds with ease none and autoRound false. Hold the completed state until 3 seconds.

styles.name: 词语强调
styles.summary: 句中重点词改变颜色和大小，周围文字变淡。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. First show "AI picks the next word" as a complete sentence, wrapping only "next word" in a separate span. At 0.65 seconds, animate "next word" to the vermilion color token and scale 1.06 over 0.65 seconds with power2.inOut, while lowering the rest of the sentence to opacity 0.32. Within a 3-second timeline, hold the completed state for the final 0.6 seconds.

styles.name: 大字反向横扫
styles.summary: 三行大字以不同速度反向横移，关键词停在中央。
styles.prompt: Build a large kinetic type sweep in <file>. Place three lines of 200px serif text at top, middle, and bottom, moving left, right, left at a speed ratio of 1 : 1.6 : 0.5. Run the middle line at constant speed for 1.95s, then stop it hard with power4.out over 0.3s so the center of {script} lands at the horizontal center. On the stop, turn only the key word vermilion, fade the other two lines to opacity 0.13 over 0.5s, and hold for at least 0.6s.

styles.name: 语境光标
styles.summary: 光标随输入内容类型变色，随后保持闪烁。
styles.prompt: Add a context-reactive caret to {script}. Use these settings: caret width 3px; blink period 0.9s at 50% duty; solid while typing; blinking resumes 0.2s after the last character. Switch color at segment boundaries in 0ms. Draw it as a pure function of time t so seeking gives identical results.

styles.name: 三维翻字解码
styles.summary: 每个字符翻过几个符号，再停在正确字形上。
styles.prompt: Reveal the text in {script} as a decode. Each glyph rotates rotateX 90deg to 0 over 0.6s while cycling 3 random symbols (seed fixed at 7) before landing on the correct glyph, starting 0.04s apart left to right. Hold the correct glyph for the last 0.1s.

styles.name: 字体轮换
styles.summary: 句子位置不变，关键词每个拍点换一种字体。
styles.prompt: In the sentence of {script} change only the key word '{script}' typeface: every 0.25 seconds cycle Playfair Display, Bebas Neue, Space Mono, Pretendard and hold the last one for 1 second. Fix the word slot to a min-width based on the widest face so the rest of the sentence never shifts, and preload the fonts.

styles.name: 字位滚轮
styles.summary: 每个字位像竖向滚轮一样转到下一字符。
styles.prompt: Convert the label in {script} to a per-glyph vertical roll. Each character lives in a one-glyph-tall slot with overflow hidden; the old glyph exits up and the new one rises from below over 0.7s power3.out, starting 0.05s apart. Split Korean by syllable.

styles.name: 手写描画
styles.summary: 笔尖按真实笔顺移动，逐步写出文字。
styles.prompt: Make the phrase in {script} write itself by hand. Normalize centerline SVG strokes with pathLength 1 and animate stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 in stroke order: 0.4s power2.inOut per stroke, 80ms between strokes, 8px round caps. Fix the order by array order.

styles.name: 行内图片展开
styles.summary: 夹在文字间的小图放大，把周围文字推开。
styles.prompt: In the sentence '<before> [image] <after>' of {script}, grow the 1em inline <image> to 70vw by 40vw over 1.6 seconds. The leading text moves -40vw left and the trailing text +40vw right while fading out, all with power2.inOut. Keep the image ratio with object-fit: cover and hold for 1 second.

styles.name: 字母重排
styles.summary: 一个词的字母移动，组成新词或列表的首字母。
styles.prompt: In {script}, make each letter of the word '<source>' travel to the initial position of the items in '<items>'. Split into spans, pre-measure the start and end coordinates and bake them into the tweens. 0.8 seconds each, 40ms apart, power3.inOut, wait 0.5 seconds after arrival and then fade in the remaining letters. Split Korean by syllable.

styles.name: 短语推入
styles.summary: 新词从右侧进入，把前面的词向左推，整句居中。
styles.prompt: Build the phrase in {script} from chunks (<chunks>). Each new chunk enters from 80px right in 0.35s with expo.out, and earlier chunks shift left by half the new chunk width so the group stays centered. 0.18s between chunks, 1s final hold.

styles.name: 引言卡搭建
styles.summary: 引号和句子依次出现，最后补上署名。
styles.prompt: Build a quote card in {script}. The large quotation mark appears at 0.3 seconds with scale 0.8 to 1; <number> lines rise 24px and fade in from 0.3 seconds, 0.5 seconds per line and 0.12 seconds apart; 0.25 seconds after the last line the attribution '<name>' slides in from the left. Ease power2.out and hold for 4 seconds in total. Break lines at meaning units.

styles.name: 重复文字墙
styles.summary: 一句话复制成许多行，铺满屏幕。
styles.prompt: Duplicate '{script}' into 7 rows filling {script}. The center row appears first and the rows spread up and down 80ms apart, 0.7 seconds per row with power3.out and 20ms between letters within a row. Only the center row is at opacity 1; the outer rows sit between 0.15 and 0.5. Split Korean by syllable.

styles.name: 融入场景的标题
styles.summary: 标题随场内线条或角色路径出现和隐藏。
styles.prompt: In the {script} scene put the title '{script}' behind the foreground object (<object>) by splitting layers. The object and the foreground mask move x 900px together over 2 seconds with power1.inOut, while the title fades in from 0.9 seconds over 0.6 seconds. The object and mask tween values must always be identical.

styles.name: 空间文字排布
styles.summary: 词语按口播顺序出现，以不同大小角度填满画面。
styles.prompt: Lay out the sentence in {script} as a spatial typographic composition. Predefine an array of {time, x, y, size, rotation} per word on a grid; the key words (<key words>) are 1.8x size and up to 15 degrees, near center. Each word scales 0.9 to 1 and fades in over 0.3s power3.out, with 250 to 600ms between words.

styles.name: 翻页字牌
styles.summary: 每张字牌的上下半片沿铰链翻转，换成新字。
styles.prompt: Turn the label in {script} into a split-flap display. Per character, the top half folds to -90deg in 0.1s and the bottom half unfolds to the new glyph in 0.1s, starting 0.04s apart, perspective 400px, hinge at the glyph midline. Split halves with clip-path and use rotateX only.

styles.name: 划线替换
styles.summary: 旧文字上画出删除线，新文字在旁边或下方出现。
styles.prompt: On {script}, draw a strikethrough over the old value left to right in 0.35s, wait 0.1s, then bring in the new value from 12px below in 0.25s. Leave the old value at 0.45 opacity after the strike. Bind all three moves in a single GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 散字聚合
styles.summary: 散落各处的字母飞回来，排成可读句子。
styles.prompt: Split the title '{script}' of {script} into per-character spans (per syllable for Korean, never per jamo). Using a seed-9 pseudo random generator, start each from x +/-200%, y +/-150%, rotation +/-30 degrees and converge to place: 0.9 seconds each, 50ms apart, power3.out, holding 1 second after the last one lands. Keep it on one paused timeline so it can be seeked.

styles.name: 文字波浪
styles.summary: 窄波沿句子扫过，只抬起经过的字符。
styles.prompt: Add a text wave to the sentence in {script}. A wave 3 glyphs wide with 16px amplitude sweeps the sentence left to right once every 1.2s; only glyphs in the wave rise and fall on a cosine curve. Lay out repetitions on the timeline instead of infinite repeat.

styles.name: 字内流动画面
styles.summary: 文字轮廓不动，视频或颜色只在字里面流动。
styles.prompt: Set the title '{script}' of {script} in 320px heavy sans and clip <image or video> inside the letters with an SVG clipPath. Over 6 seconds move the fill x from -120px to 120px and scale from 1.15 to 1.3 with sine.inOut, keeping the letter outline fixed. Use one paused timeline so it can be seeked.

styles.name: 字距收拢
styles.summary: 分得很开的字母逐渐靠拢，组成紧凑标题。
styles.prompt: Add a tracking reveal to the title in {script}. Pull the letters from 0.2em offsets around the center to 0 over 0.8s power2.out while opacity goes 0 to 1. Use per-glyph transform x instead of letter-spacing to avoid reflow; hold 1s at the end.

styles.name: 可变字体变形
styles.summary: 文字的粗细和宽度持续变化。
styles.prompt: Morph the word in {script} along variable-font axes: over 0.7s go wght 300 to 800 and wdth 80 to 100 with power2.inOut, glyph starts 0.06s apart. Fix the container width to the final state and forbid wrapping so layout never moves.

styles.name: 字重波浪
styles.summary: 粗细和倾斜变化像波浪一样穿过字母。
styles.prompt: Add a variable-font weight wave to the headline in {script}. A wave 4 glyphs wide sweeps the line once every 1.5s, raising wght from 300 to 900 and slnt from 0 to -10 on the glyphs it touches, then relaxing. Fix glyph slot widths so the line width never changes, and compute axes purely from t.

styles.name: 大词接力
styles.summary: 大词从右进入，中央停一下，再向左让给下一词。
styles.prompt: Build a word relay in {script}. Big words <words> enter from 900px right in 0.4s power3.out, hold at center for 0.6s, and exit 900px left in 0.3s power2.in as the next takes over. Keep the last word. Use a single seekable timeline.

styles.name: 词语上升淡入
styles.summary: 词语微微上升并去掉模糊，依次停稳。
styles.prompt: Reveal the sentence in {script} word by word. Each word rises 12px, fades 0 to 1 and de-blurs from 6px to 0 over 0.35s with power2.out, staggered 0.08s. Finish within 1.2s and hold for 1s.

styles.name: 词槽轮换
styles.summary: 句子固定部分不动，一个字槽不断轮换词语。
styles.prompt: Build a fixed-slot word cycle in {script}. Keep the sentence frame static and cycle 4 words (<words>) in the blank: hold 0.6s, swap over 0.25s (outgoing rises and fades, incoming enters from below). Fix the slot width to the widest word so nothing reflows; keep Korean postpositions outside the slot.

styles.name: 交叉淡化
styles.summary: 旧场景淡出的同时，新场景淡入。
styles.prompt: Create a crossfade by placing scenes A and B of {script} at the same coordinates. Starting at 0.35 seconds over 0.8 seconds, simultaneously animate A opacity from 1 to 0 and B opacity from 0 to 1 with ease none. Hold the completed scene from 1.5 to 3 seconds and use only one vermilion focal point.

styles.name: 推挤转场
styles.summary: 新场景沿同一方向，把旧场景等距推出画面。
styles.prompt: Create a push transition for {script} by placing scenes A and B side by side on one rail, each 1168px wide. Place B at x 1168px and animate only the parent rail to x -1168px starting at 0.35 seconds over 1.2 seconds with power2.inOut. Hold the completed scene from 1.9 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 边界擦除
styles.summary: 移动边界逐步露出后面的新场景。
styles.prompt: Overlay the two scenes in {script} and start B with clip-path inset(0% 100% 0% 0%). Starting at 0.35 seconds over 1.2 seconds, animate the right inset to 0% while moving a 4px vermilion vertical line from x 0 to 1164px. Use ease none and a total duration of 3 seconds. Hold the completed state after 1.9 seconds.

styles.name: 圆形遮罩转场
styles.summary: 圆形窗口从一点扩大，露出下一个场景。
styles.prompt: Create a circular mask transition for {script} that opens from a point. Place a vermilion dot at the center of a 1168×580 scene, at 584px, 290px. Animate scene B's clip-path from circle(0px at 584px 290px) to circle(680px at 584px 290px). Expand starting at 0.4 seconds over 1.35 seconds with power2.inOut, and hold after 2.2 seconds.

styles.name: 形状匹配切镜
styles.summary: 两个场景在相同位置保留大小相近的形状后切换。
styles.prompt: Create a match cut for {script} connecting the sentence's vermilion period to a chart dot. Starting at 0.35 seconds, enlarge the period from scale 0.25 to 1 over 0.5 seconds with power2.out, maintaining final center (568,322) and diameter 48px. At 1.25 seconds, hide A and immediately show B, with B's dot at the same center and size. Hold from 1.8 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 图形变形转场
styles.summary: 同一元素改变形状和颜色，成为下一场景的一部分。
styles.prompt: Transform the ink-black square in {script} into a vermilion circle and then a bar using the same DOM element. Starting at 0.35 seconds over 0.7 seconds, change the 200×200px square from border-radius 0% to 50% while turning it vermilion. Starting at 1.25 seconds over 0.75 seconds, animate x from 420 to 0, scaleX to 3.1, scaleY to 0.16, and border-radius to 0%. Reveal scene B starting at 1.75 seconds over 0.3 seconds, and hold after 2.35 seconds.

styles.name: 甩镜转场
styles.summary: 画面快速横扫并带横向模糊，再急停到新场景。
styles.prompt: Create a leftward whip-pan transition for {script}. Place A and B, each 1168px wide, side by side in one strip. Starting at 1.03 seconds over 0.42 seconds, animate x from 0 to -1168px with power4.inOut. Tween a proxy for SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation, increasing horizontal blur from 0 to 28px over 0.21 seconds, then restoring it to 0 over 0.21 seconds. Keep vertical blur at 0. Hold the completed state after 1.95 seconds.

styles.name: 穿字推进
styles.summary: 字母内部空洞不断放大，镜头穿过去进入下一场景。
styles.prompt: Create a zoom-through transition through the letter O for {script}. Place an O with opening radii 95px and 140px at the center of a 1168×580 scene, at 584px, 290px. Starting at 0.4 seconds over 1.35 seconds, enlarge it to 8 times its size with power3.in. Scale the scene beneath the opening from 0.18 to 1 starting at 0.7 seconds over 1.15 seconds, and hold after 2.25 seconds.

styles.name: 模糊叠化
styles.summary: 两场景在模糊中重叠交换，新场景随后变清晰。
styles.prompt: Build a blur dissolve between <targetA> and <targetB> in GSAP. Over 0.7 seconds, A blurs from 0 to 12px while fading to opacity 0, and B goes from 12px blur to 0 while fading to opacity 1. Use power1.inOut, start both at the same time, and keep everything in a single paused timeline that supports seeking.

styles.name: 弹跳转场
styles.summary: 场景边界带阴影下落弹跳，逐步露出新场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Bounce Transition to {script}. The next scene falls from y -1080px over 0.9s with bounce.out, while a shadow layer (7.5% of frame height, black at 0.6 opacity) moves with it using the same ease. Hold 0.4s after landing. Use a single seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 燃烧转场
styles.summary: 不规则烧边向外扩散，擦掉旧场景并留下热光。
styles.prompt: Build a burn transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Raise a fixed-seed (seed 1) noise mask threshold from 0 to 1 over 1 second with power1.inOut to burn A away and reveal B, with a #ff8a3d glowing band about 1% of the frame wide at the edge. No Math.random; drive progress from a GSAP state object in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 色差擦除
styles.summary: 画面滑走时颜色通道分开，到新画面后重新合拢。
styles.prompt: Build a chromatic wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. Split A's red copy to -80px and blue copy to +80px over 0.25 seconds while wiping left to right over 0.5 seconds, then bring the channels back to 0 in the last 0.25 seconds. Use power3.inOut, mix-blend-mode screen, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 时钟擦除
styles.summary: 扇形边缘绕中心旋转，扫出下一个场景。
styles.prompt: Reveal <targetB> over <targetA> with a clock wipe. Start at 12 o'clock and sweep clockwise 360 degrees over 0.8 seconds, center at 50% 50%, ease none (linear). Build the mask with conic-gradient, read the angle from a GSAP state object, and keep it in one paused timeline that supports seeking.

styles.name: 竖条熔化
styles.summary: 画面切成竖条，以不同速度下坠，像屏幕融化。
styles.prompt: Apply a Column Melt transition to {script} when switching to the next scene. Split the frame into 30 vertical strips, give each a fixed delay between 0 and 0.25s, and drop each by 1080px over 0.75s with power1.in. Total length 1.0s, with the next scene already sitting underneath. Use one seekable GSAP timeline and no Math.random.

styles.name: 立方体翻面
styles.summary: 两个场景像立方体相邻面一样转动，底下带倒影。
styles.prompt: Add a Cube Transition between the two scenes in {script}. Set perspective 1600px on the parent. Rotate the previous scene from 0 to -90deg around its right edge (100% 50%) and the next scene from 90deg to 0 around its left edge (0% 50%), over 0.8s with power3.inOut. Use backface-visibility hidden, and keep it on a single seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 纯色过渡
styles.summary: 旧场景淡进一片纯色，新场景再从纯色中浮现。
styles.prompt: Add a dip-to-color transition from <targetA> to <targetB> in GSAP. A fades out behind a #000 color layer over 0.25 seconds, the color holds for 0.1 seconds, then B fades in over 0.35 seconds. Use power1.in for the exit and power2.out for the entrance, all in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 白闪转场
styles.summary: 白光盖满画面，最亮时切换场景，再恢复亮度。
styles.prompt: Add a flash transition between <targetA> and <targetB>. A full-frame #fff overlay rises to opacity 1 over 0.1 seconds and holds for 2 frames (0.067s at 30fps), during which A is hidden and B shown, then falls to 0 over 0.25 seconds. Use power2.in going up, power2.out coming down, in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 网点溶解
styles.summary: 网格上的圆洞逐渐长大连成片，露出新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a halftone dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. Lay a 16px grid of circle masks and grow each radius from 0 to 12px, starting with the cells nearest the origin (50% 50%). Use a 15ms delay per cell, 0.5 seconds per cell, 0.9 seconds total, and power2.inOut. Compute circle positions deterministically in code and use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 翻页转场
styles.summary: 页面角卷起，露出背面和软阴影，再翻向下一页。
styles.prompt: Add a Page Turn transition at the end of {script}. Run it right to left over 900ms with power2.inOut, curl radius 16% of frame width, and a 0.25 opacity shadow behind the curl. Make the back side 10% darker. Drive it with one progress value p and a drawCurl(p) function so seeking a paused timeline yields identical frames.

styles.name: 透视换位
styles.summary: 两个场景像透视卡片一样前后左右换位，倒影跟随。
styles.prompt: Add a Perspective Swap between the cards in {script}. Set perspective 1800px on the stage, run 0.8s with power3.inOut. .front moves to x +420, z -300, scale 0.82; .back travels from x -420 to 0 and comes forward. Swap zIndex exactly once at 0.4s. Keep everything on one seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 涟漪叠化
styles.summary: 同心波纹从一点扩散，扭曲画面并露出下一场景。
styles.prompt: Build a ripple dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. Ripples spread from the center (50% 50%) over 0.9 seconds, displacement amplitude decays from 30px to 0, and B is revealed inside the ripple radius. Use power2.out, drive it with a single GSAP state object, and keep it in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 旋转瓦片叠化
styles.summary: 画面分成旋转的小块，同时混入下一场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Rotating Tile Dissolve to {script}. Repeat the frame as 2x2 tiles, rotate it 90deg over 0.7s with linear ease while scale goes 1 to 1.25 and back. Fade the next scene in from 0 to 1 between 35% and 65% of progress. Make sure no empty edges show and keep it on one seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 缩放换位
styles.summary: 旧元素缩向锚点，新元素放大接替它的位置。
styles.prompt: Scale-swap <targetA> for <targetB>. Stack them in the same spot with transformOrigin 50% 50%. A goes scale 1 to 0.2 and opacity 1 to 0 over 0.55 seconds (power2.in). B starts at 0.275 seconds and goes scale 0.2 to 1 and opacity 0 to 1 over 0.55 seconds (back.out(1.4)). Use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 分半滑移
styles.summary: 画面两半向相反方向分开或合拢，完成场景交换。
styles.prompt: Add a Split Slide transition to {script}. Duplicate the previous scene into two halves; slide the left half to x -960 and the right half to x +960 over 0.65s with power3.inOut, starting at the same position. The next scene must already sit underneath. Hide the halves when done. One seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 挤压转场
styles.summary: 旧场景沿一个轴压扁，新场景从同一边展开。
styles.prompt: Build a squeeze transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Set transformOrigin to 0% 50%. A goes scaleX 1 to 0 over 0.3 seconds with power2.in, then B goes scaleX 0 to 1 over 0.35 seconds with power2.out from the same origin. Use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 双目窗口换景
styles.summary: 圆角画面缩小分成两份转开，暗隙后新画面展开。
styles.prompt: Add a Stereo Viewer Swap to {script}. First 0.3s: shrink the previous scene to scale 0.88 with a corner radius of 22% of frame height. Next 0.3s: two copies rotateY to -90 and +90. Last 0.3s: the new scene scales from 0.88 to 1 and its radius returns to 0. Keep the dark gap under 30% of the total. One seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 切向模糊旋转
styles.summary: 场景绕角点旋转，沿轨迹切线拖出模糊并换景。
styles.prompt: Add a Tangent Blur Spin to {script}. Rotate the previous scene 0 to -75deg around its bottom-right corner and the next scene 75deg to 0 over 0.65s, with blur peaking at 6px at the midpoint (0.32s) and returning to 0. Use cubic-bezier(0.68,0.01,0.17,0.98) and a single seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 亮色叠加转场
styles.summary: 两场景亮色相加，中间变亮后落到新场景。
styles.prompt: Add an Additive Dissolve to {script}. Give .next mix-blend-mode plus-lighter, then tween .prev opacity 1 to 0 and .next 0 to 1 over 0.6s with linear ease. Apply brightness 0.85 with a 0.3s yoyo so the middle does not clip. Keep it on a paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 条带错位滑移
styles.summary: 横条或竖条略微错时滑动，露出下一个画面。
styles.prompt: Add a Band Slide to {script}. Split the frame into 8 horizontal bands of 135px; each slides to x 1920 over 0.47s with power3.inOut, band i starting i*0.04s later, so the last band ends at 0.75s. Place the next scene underneath in advance. One seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 通道错时叠化
styles.summary: 红绿蓝通道在不同时间交给新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a channel phase dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB> over 0.7 seconds. The R channel hands over during 0.0 to 0.6 of the duration, G during 0.2 to 0.8, and B during 0.4 to 1.0. Keep the three channel mix values in state objects, use ease none, and keep everything in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 章节插卡
styles.summary: 两场景之间出现步骤标题卡，短暂停留后继续。
styles.prompt: Add a Chapter Interstitial between steps in {script}. .chapter (number and title) enters from y +24px, opacity 0 over 0.25s with power2.out, holds 1.2s, then exits from 1.45s over 0.25s to y -24px, opacity 0 with power2.in. Show the next scene at 1.7s. Take the title as a variable.

styles.name: 重复方格擦除
styles.summary: 重复同一词的方格铺满画面，反色后退去。
styles.prompt: Build a clone wall wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. Clone '{script}' into an 8x6 grid of 48 tiles, fill from top left to bottom right at 20ms intervals with each tile going opacity 0 and scale 0.8 to full over 0.2 seconds (power2.out). Once full, swap A for B and clear in the same order. Use mix-blend-mode difference and one paused timeline.

styles.name: 色差分区叠化
styles.summary: 两场景颜色差异大的区域与相近区域以不同速度交替。
styles.prompt: Build a color distance dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. Ramp progress p from 0 to 1 over 0.8 seconds with ease none. Per pixel, compute the color distance d between the two scenes and mix with smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, p*1.1 - pow(d, 5.0)). Read progress from one GSAP state object in a paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 交叉剪辑
styles.summary: 两个地点或两组动作交替出现。
styles.prompt: Add Cross Cutting to {script}. Alternate .a and .b using the gap array [1.5, 1.1, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5] seconds, swapping instantly with tl.set. Keep the internal time of both scenes running, distinguish them by color temperature, and show a merge scene after the last cut.

styles.name: 插入旁镜
styles.summary: 主动作被短暂的关联镜头打断，随后返回。
styles.prompt: Add a Cutaway to {script} at 3.0s. Show the related layer .cut at 3.0s and hide it at 4.2s. The main video keeps playing during the cutaway; hold 0.7s after returning. Use tl.set only with no transition tweens, and make it seekable on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 压缩错帧转场
styles.summary: 横条竖缝撕裂画面，旧影像拖开后交给新画面。
styles.prompt: Add a Datamosh Transition to {script}. Duplicate the previous scene into 42 horizontal strips; push each by a seeded-hash offset between -150 and +150px over 0.6s with linear ease, and fade each out over 0.2s starting at 0.4s. Bring a residue layer up to opacity 0.62 and back. Use only a seeded hash for randomness and keep it on a paused, seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 边缘线稿化
styles.summary: 照片表面消失，只剩轮廓边线。
styles.prompt: Add an edge trace transition to the photo in {script}. Starting at 0.3 seconds, mix from the original to a Sobel edge drawing (white paper, dark navy lines #111827) from 0 to 1 over 0.8 seconds with power2.inOut. Threshold smoothstep(0.15, 0.30). Hold the line drawing for 0.6 seconds, then bring in annotation text.

styles.name: 先退后入
styles.summary: 旧元素完全消失后，新元素才出现。
styles.prompt: Replace <oldElement> with <newElement> using exit-before-enter. The old element fades to opacity 0 and moves y -12px over 0.25 seconds (power2.in), then display none. Right after, the new element goes from opacity 0 and y +12px to rest over 0.4 seconds (power2.out). No frame should show both elements, and everything sits in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 视线匹配
styles.summary: 人物看向画外后，切到那个方向的物体。
styles.prompt: Add an Eyeline Match to {script}. Move the character gaze toward the upper right from 0.2s to 0.7s, then cut to the target scene .target at 1.0s using tl.set. Place the target in the upper right of the frame and ease it from scale 1.06 to 1 over 0.6s with power2.out. Hold 1.0s after the cut.

styles.name: 复眼转场
styles.summary: 画面碎成许多折射小镜片，分色后转向下一场景。
styles.prompt: Build a fly-eye transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Divide the frame into a lens grid with cell size 0.04, ramp progress p from 0 to 1 linearly over 0.8 seconds, and apply refraction zoom 50*sin(pi*p), color separation 0.3*sin(pi*p), and blend by p. Read values from one state object in a paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 边框遮挡转场
styles.summary: 粗边框移动或长大，遮住切点并围住新画面。
styles.prompt: Add a Frame Border Transition to {script}. A brand-colored rectangular border (.frame-fill) closes in from scale 1.6 to 1 over 0.325s with power3.in, covering the frame. Swap scenes at 0.325s, then expand it back to scale 1.6 over 0.325s with power3.out, leaving an 80px border around the new scene. Paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 定格切镜
styles.summary: 动作在某个瞬间定住，短暂停留后换场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Freeze Cut to {script} at 2.0s. Copy the frame at that time to a canvas (.freeze), show it for 0.4s while slowly scaling from 1 to 1.04 with ease none, and cut to .next at 2.4s. Draw the frame from the seeked time so it stays deterministic.

styles.name: 定格贴纸装饰
styles.summary: 动作在拍点冻结，纸片、胶带和标签贴到主体周围。
styles.prompt: Add freeze-frame dressing to <video> at <time> seconds. Swap that frame for a still image and stick three elements (tape, paper, label) on at 80ms intervals, each going scale 0.6 to 1, rotation -6deg to 0, y -24px to 0 over 0.25 seconds with back.out(1.6). Hold 1 second, then resume playback, all in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 故障转场
styles.summary: 画面块短暂错位，色彩通道与残影散开后切换。
styles.prompt: Add a Glitch Transition to {script}. Total 450ms stepped at 24fps. Block x displacement up to 77px (4% of width), R channel +27px, B channel -27px (1.4%), peaking at 225ms. Use only a seeded hash of the frame number for randomness, and swap to the next scene at 225ms. Keep it on a paused GSAP timeline so it seeks deterministically.

styles.name: 引力透镜
styles.summary: 画面向中心弯曲，光聚成环，再恢复成新画面。
styles.prompt: Build a gravitational lens transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Center at 50% 50%, lens radius 0.35. Raise displacement strength from 0 to 0.1 over 0.6 seconds (sine.in), swap to B at that point, then lower it back to 0 over 0.6 seconds (sine.out). Limit ring brightness to +25%, read values from a GSAP state object, and keep it in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 黑白叠化
styles.summary: 两场景先褪成黑白混合，新场景再恢复颜色。
styles.prompt: Build a grayscale dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. A goes grayscale 0 to 1 over 0.4 seconds while its opacity falls 1 to 0 over 0.8 seconds. B starts at grayscale 1 and opacity 0, reaches opacity 1 over 0.8 seconds, and regains color (grayscale 0) over 0.4 seconds starting at 0.4 seconds. Use ease none in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 方格翻面
styles.summary: 场景切成矩形小块，依次翻面露出背后的新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a grid flip from <targetA> to <targetB>. Split the frame into 8x5 tiles, each rotating rotationY 0 to 180 over 0.6 seconds with power2.inOut and showing B on the back. Stagger 30ms from top left to bottom right, apply perspective 900px once on the parent, and set backface-visibility hidden. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 直接切镜
styles.summary: 画面直接换成下一张，没有重叠过程。
styles.prompt: Add a hard cut from scene A to B in {script} with GSAP. At 3.0s use tl.set to set A to autoAlpha 0 and B to autoAlpha 1 in the same frame, with no transition. Hold B for at least 3 seconds. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 旧景延时重叠
styles.summary: 旧场景短暂保留，延迟结束时再露出新场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Held Scene Overlap to {script}. Keep the previous scene's timeline running until 1.8s, start the next scene's timeline at 1.2s so its sound comes first, and swap visibility at 1.8s with tl.set. Build each scene as a child timeline attached with tl.add, seekable on a paused parent timeline.

styles.name: 色相叠化
styles.summary: 场景混合时色相沿色环移动，饱和度和明度一起变化。
styles.prompt: Build an HSV-style dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. A goes hue-rotate 0 to 60deg, saturate 1 to 1.3, opacity 1 to 0 over 0.7 seconds while B goes hue-rotate -60deg to 0, saturate 1.3 to 1, opacity 0 to 1 at the same time. Use ease none in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 细节插镜
styles.summary: 全景动作之间短暂插入手或物体的近景。
styles.prompt: Add an Insert Shot to {script}. At 2.0s hide .wide and show the detail layer .detail for 1.0s, then return to the wide shot at 3.0s and hold 0.7s more. Both layers play on the same time flow. Use tl.set only, no transition tweens.

styles.name: 跳切
styles.summary: 相同构图中，人物或状态突然跳到另一时刻。
styles.prompt: Add Jump Cuts to {script}. Set cut times to 0, 0.5, 1.1, and 1.6s; alternate between scale 1, x 0 and scale 1.08, x -40px using tl.set so changes are instant. No transition tweens, and keep the audio continuous. Make it seekable on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 万花筒转场
styles.summary: 画面折成对称碎片旋转，混入新场景后展开。
styles.prompt: Build a kaleidoscope transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Fold A into 6 symmetric sectors by raising fold from 0 to 1 (sine.in) and rotation from 0 to 90 degrees over 0.5 seconds, swap to B at the peak, then unfold fold from 1 to 0 (sine.out) over 0.5 seconds. Read values from a GSAP state object in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 镜头光斑转场
styles.summary: 强光点和光学圆环穿过画面，遮住切点后消退。
styles.prompt: Add a Lens Flare Transition to {script}. Overlay .flare (a light point plus three rings) with mix-blend-mode plus-lighter, moving from (-300,-200) to (2200,1300) over 0.5s with sine.inOut. Opacity rises to 1 by 0.25s and falls back; at 0.25s swap .prev for .next. Keep the pure white frame under 100ms.

styles.name: 漏光转场
styles.summary: 大片不规则彩光铺开，盖住切点后淡去。
styles.prompt: Add a light leak transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. An orange (#ff8a3d) and white radial-gradient patch layer (mix-blend-mode screen) rises over 0.3 seconds from opacity 0 to 0.3 and x -300px to 0. During a 50ms hold, swap A for B, then exit over 0.35 seconds to opacity 0 and x 300px. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 光束转场
styles.summary: 光束从一点伸长盖满画面，再散开露出新场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Light Ray Transition to {script}. Place 24 gradient bars at the frame center with rotation i*15deg and scale their Y from 0 to 1 over 0.3s with power3.out. Swap scenes at 0.3s and fade the whole ray group to opacity 0 over the next 0.3s. No randomness, on a paused seekable timeline.

styles.name: 亮度擦除
styles.summary: 按影像或灰度图的亮度顺序，逐区换成新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a luma wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. Using the luminance of <mapFile>, raise a threshold from 0 to 1 over 0.85 seconds with power1.inOut so B opens from the darkest pixels first. Edge softness 0.08. Read the threshold from a GSAP state object in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 明度熔化
styles.summary: 画面按明度和噪声纹理向上或向下融掉。
styles.prompt: Build a luminance melt from <targetA> to <targetB>. Ramp progress p from 0 to 1 over 0.9 seconds with ease none. Per pixel, switch to B where melt = p*1.4 - uv.y*direction - (0.2 if luma > 0.8) - fixedNoise*0.3 goes above 0. Use a fixed noise texture in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 动作匹配切镜
styles.summary: 切镜前后保持动作方向和速度，让两景连成一次动作。
styles.prompt: Build a match on action cut for {script}: the scene A card exits right over 400ms with power2.in, cut at 1.0 seconds, and the scene B card enters from the left over 400ms with power2.out. Use 1300px of travel for both so direction and speed continue, and make the cut happen off screen.

styles.name: 镜像转场
styles.summary: 画面复制成镜像，向中间折叠后展开成新画面。
styles.prompt: Add a Mirror Transition to {script}. Set perspective 1600px. Split the previous scene into top and bottom halves and fold them to the center line (y 540) over 0.35s with rotationX -90 and 90 (power3.in). Then unfold the new scene halves in reverse over 0.35s (power3.out). One seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 蒙太奇
styles.summary: 多个短画面连续切换，把较长过程压缩呈现。
styles.prompt: Add a Montage to {script}. Cut .shot-0 through .shot-4 with durations [1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6]s using tl.set only, then hold the final result shot .result for 1.0s. No transition effects. If music is present, align the cuts to the beat.

styles.name: 形状匹配再形变
styles.summary: 相同位置的圆形切成字母，再连续变成环形图。
styles.prompt: Connect the {script} scenes with a morph match cut. Grow a 360px vermilion circle centered at (640,290) over 0.7s with power3.out, then at 1.15s cut in a single frame to a serif letter O with the same center and height (outer ellipse 135x180, inner 92x162, evenodd path). From 1.6s, interpolate over 1s with power3.inOut to outer radius 180 and inner 120 to morph into a donut, swap to a 60px stroked circle, and rewind it to 62% with stroke-dashoffset 0 to 0.38 (autoRound:false). Push the world wrapper from scale 1 to 1.06, pan x by -170px during the morph, and hold still for the last 0.6s.

styles.name: 马赛克穿行
styles.summary: 影像铺成重复方格，镜头沿格子移动进入新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a mosaic traverse from <targetA> to <targetB>. Place A and B in a 3x3 tile world, zoom out from scale 1 to 0.33 over 0.3 seconds (power3.in), move by tile (2, -1) over 0.3 seconds (power2.inOut), then zoom in to scale 1 on B's tile over 0.3 seconds (power3.out). Transforms only, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 正片叠底转场
styles.summary: 两场景相乘形成较暗的中间态，再恢复新景亮度。
styles.prompt: Build a multiply dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. Bring B over A with mix-blend-mode multiply, opacity 0 to 1 over 0.35 seconds, then fade A to opacity 0 over the next 0.35 seconds and return B's blend mode to normal. Use ease none in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 噪声溶解
styles.summary: 旧场景上的斑驳孔洞逐步扩散，露出下一场景。
styles.prompt: Add a noise dissolve transition in <file> when {script} hands off to the next scene. Draw the outgoing scene to a canvas once, compute 4-octave value noise per pixel (lattices 190, 95, 48, 16px, fixed seed) and equalize it to 0..1 by rank. Pixels whose noise is below the progress become transparent, a 0.022-wide band at the edge is painted vermilion, and the transition runs 1.9s with power1.inOut. When it ends, turn only the key element of the next scene vermilion and hold 0.6s.

styles.name: 折纸转场
styles.summary: 画面折成几块并缩小，新场景从折面中展开。
styles.prompt: Add an Origami Fold to {script}. Set perspective 2000px and split the previous scene into 4 panels of 480px. Panel i starts i*0.06s later and rotates on Y to -90 (even) or 90 (odd) over 0.5s with power3.inOut, while a shade layer rises to opacity 0.3. Then unfold the new scene the same way in reverse. Paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 轮廓溶解
styles.summary: 填色退去只留下亮边，新场景再填回颜色。
styles.prompt: Add an Outline Dissolve to {script}. Fade .prev-fill to opacity 0 over the first 0.35s, leaving a 2px white line layer (.prev-line). From 0.3s show the new scene lines in the same position, then fill .next-fill from 0 to 1 over 0.35s starting at 0.35s. Total 0.7s, ease none, on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 前景桥接
styles.summary: 同一前景图形扫过切镜前后的画面，把两景连起来。
styles.prompt: Add an Overlay Bridge to {script}. A logo shape (.bridge, width 120% of frame) travels from x -2300 to 2300 over 0.5s with power2.inOut. At 0.25s, when it fully covers the frame center, hide .prev and show .next. Keep the overlay on its own layer above both scenes, on a paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 泼墨擦除
styles.summary: 不规则颜料块和点逐步铺开，露出下一场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Paint Splatter Wipe to {script}. Use the SVG blob #splat as a mask, growing its scale from 0 to 1.6 over 0.7s with power3.out to reveal the next scene. 12 surrounding dots scale 0 to 1 with a 0.01s stagger. Verify no pixels of the previous scene remain in the final frame, on a paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 余辉叠化
styles.summary: 上一画面的明亮物体留下光尾，延续到新画面。
styles.prompt: Add a Phosphor Dissolve to {script}. Show .next from 0s and let the bright-only .trail layer (green #7CFFB2) decay by 0.85 per frame at 24fps over 0.8s. Compute opacity from the frame number with tl.set so seeking gives identical results.

styles.name: 反应切镜
styles.summary: 事件或台词之后，切到旁观者的表情和反应。
styles.prompt: Add a Reaction Cut to {script} after the line ends at 2.0s. At 2.1s hide .speaker and show .reaction with tl.set, and let .reaction ease from scale 1.05 to 1 over 0.8s. Keep the tail of the speech audio playing over the reaction.

styles.name: 后退覆盖
styles.summary: 旧场景缩小变暗，新场景滑进来盖住它。
styles.prompt: Build a retreat-and-cover transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Over 0.7 seconds A retreats from scale 1 to 0.71 and brightness 1 to 0.6, while B slides in from x 1920px to 0 at the same time and covers it. Use power1.inOut, B on top, and one paused timeline.

styles.name: 同心环推进
styles.summary: 同心圆环显示不同放大倍率，从中心开始换景。
styles.prompt: Build a ring zoom from <targetA> to <targetB>. Create three concentric rings at the frame center and scale A inside each to 1.0, 1.4, and 2.0 linearly over 0.8 seconds. Swap to B starting with the center ring at 0.2-second intervals and feather the ring edges by 2px. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 涂鸦擦除
styles.summary: 涂鸦线快速叠满画面，再擦开露出下一场景。
styles.prompt: Build a scribble wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. Draw 12 SVG scribble strokes top to bottom with a 30ms stagger, each animating strokeDashoffset over 0.3 seconds with power2.out to cover the frame. At the covered moment (0.36s) hide A and show B, then erase the strokes over 0.3 seconds. Keep the stroke coordinates in a fixed array and use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 弯曲斜线擦除
styles.summary: 柔软斜边扫过画面，边缘两侧影像跟着拉伸拖开。
styles.prompt: Write a new WebGL directional warp wipe in <file> that hands {script} off to the next plate. Draw both plates to 2D canvases after fonts load and use them as textures; move the edge along 45-degree diagonal coordinates from -0.16 to 1.16 with u_p and bend it with two sines (0.08 and 0.03). Blend across a ±0.035 smoothstep and, weighted by a Gaussian k around the edge, stretch both plates 0.10 along the travel direction with 28 smear samples. Drive u_p with a 2.0s sine.inOut GSAP proxy tween and hold 0.7s at the end.
styles.attribution: [gl-transitions, directionalwarp (아이디어 참고)](https://github.com/gl-transitions/gl-transitions/blob/master/transitions/directionalwarp.glsl)；[MDN, WebGL tutorial: Using textures in WebGL](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/WebGL_API/Tutorial/Using_textures_in_WebGL)

styles.name: 碎裂转场
styles.summary: 画面碎成小片散开露出新景，也可反向聚成新景。
styles.prompt: Build a shatter transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. Split A into 30 clipPath polygon fragments; each flies out on a fixed seeded path up to 30% of the frame, rotating 120 degrees per second and fading to opacity 0 over 1.0 second with power2.in, with 0 to 0.08 second start delays. No Math.random, B waits behind, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 正反打
styles.summary: 两个说话人的相对视角随台词和反应交替出现。
styles.prompt: Add Shot Reverse Shot to the dialogue in {script}. Keep .shot-a facing right and .shot-b facing left. Alternate them with tl.set at [0, 2.0, 3.8, 5.4]s, cutting 0.1s before each line ends. Keep one continuous audio track.

styles.name: 突变切镜
styles.summary: 两个反差很大的场景毫无预告地直接切换。
styles.prompt: Add a Smash Cut at 1.0s in {script}. Hide .a (dark, quiet scene) with tl.set at 1.0s and show .b (bright scene) at the same time. Let .b settle from scale 1.05 to 1 over 0.18s with power3.out, once. Align the audio change to 1.0s.

styles.name: 局部反相叠化
styles.summary: 画面经过高反差和局部反色状态，再换成新景。
styles.prompt: Add a Solarized Dissolve to {script}. Run p from 0 to 1 over 0.6s with linear ease and apply filter invert(0.85k) contrast(1+0.4k) saturate(1+0.2k) to both scenes with k = sin(pi*p). Swap .prev for .next at 0.3s. Only p is interpolated, so a paused timeline seeks exactly.

styles.name: 速度坡道
styles.summary: 动作高潮变慢，前后运动加速通过。
styles.prompt: Apply Speed Ramp to {script} in <file>. Integrate a continuous speed curve over 2000ms: ramp from 4x to 0.25x in 300ms, hold slow motion for 800ms, then ramp back to 4x in 300ms. Draw the source at the integrated time for deterministic seeking. Use none and a paused GSAP core timeline that produces identical states when seeking backward.

styles.name: 声音错位切镜
styles.summary: 声音提前进入新场景，或在画面切换后继续旧声。
styles.prompt: Add a J-cut to the A to B scene in {script} with GSAP and an audio track. The picture hard-cuts at 3.0s in one frame, while B's audio fades in from 2.6s over 0.15s so it is heard 0.4s early. Lower the old audio by 12dB from 2.6s. Split into labels cutPicture and cutAudio on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 分面板交接
styles.summary: 标题上下分开，开口中的面板长大接管屏幕。
styles.prompt: Build a split-panel handoff from {script} to <panel>. Split the title into top and bottom halves; the top goes y -300px and the bottom y +300px over 0.8 seconds (power3.inOut). The panel scales from 0 to 1 starting at 0.2 seconds for 0.6 seconds (power3.out). Split along the title's horizontal center and keep it in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 噪声横带擦除
styles.summary: 水平噪声带向上或向下扫过，身后变成新场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Static Band Wipe to {script}. A noise band 130px tall travels top to bottom over 0.55s with linear ease, while .next opens via clipPath inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0 0 0% 0) at the same speed, so everything just behind the band is the next scene. Seed the noise by frame number and keep one seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 旋涡转场
styles.summary: 画面绕一点扭成漩涡，再在下一场景里松开。
styles.prompt: Build a swirl transition from <targetA> to <targetB> with WebGL or an SVG filter. Center at 50% 50%, influence radius 80% of the short side, max rotation 180 degrees. Ramp the angle from 0 to max over 0.45 seconds (power2.in) to twist A, swap to B at that point, then unwind to 0 over 0.45 seconds (power2.out). Read the angle from a GSAP state value in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 时间压缩
styles.summary: 等待和重复动作被快放或省略，直接推进到结果。
styles.prompt: Compress the wait in the {script} progress video to 4x with GSAP. From 1.0s over 10s raise the video currentTime from 0 to 40 linearly, and at the same time show a 4x badge from opacity 0, scale 0.9 over 0.15s, hold 1.5s and fade over 0.15s. Then hold the result screen at least 1.5s. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 热色叠化
styles.summary: 旧场景偏向热色调，同时混进下一场景。
styles.prompt: Build a tinted burn dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. A and B cross linearly over 0.7 seconds, and over them a #e6663a tint layer (mix-blend-mode screen) rises from opacity 0 to 0.5 over 0.35 seconds (sine.in) and falls back to 0 over 0.35 seconds (sine.out). One paused timeline.

styles.name: 移位淡化
styles.summary: 旧元素边移走边变淡，新元素在同一区域变清晰。
styles.prompt: Apply a Translate Fade when swapping content in {script}. .old goes to x -576px and opacity 0; .new goes from x 576px, opacity 0 to x 0, opacity 1; both over 0.7s with power2.inOut, starting together. Set the opacity crossover around 40% progress so text does not overlap legibly, and keep it on one seekable paused timeline.

styles.name: 电视雪花转场
styles.summary: 灰色噪点短暂盖住或混入画面，再露出下一场景。
styles.prompt: Add a TV Static Transition to {script}. Over 500ms, raise .static opacity from 0 to 1 in 200ms, swap scenes at 200ms, then lower it back to 0 over 200ms starting at 300ms. Draw the noise on a canvas seeded by the frame number and avoid Math.random. Keep it on one seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 电视跟踪转场
styles.summary: 扫描线横向晃动，暗条出现，两个场景交替。
styles.prompt: Add a TV Tracking Transition to {script}. Split the frame into 120 horizontal lines and shift about 35% of them with translateX = sin(i + p*12) * 60 * sin(pi*p) px, over 0.7s with linear ease. Swap to the next scene at 50% progress, and run a 0.35-opacity dark scan bar down the frame once. Interpolate only p on one paused timeline so it seeks deterministically.

styles.name: 扭曲叠化
styles.summary: 新旧场景向相反方向拉弯，交换后逐渐恢复。
styles.prompt: Build a warp dissolve between <targetA> and <targetB>. Ramp progress p from 0 to 1 over 0.9 seconds with power2.inOut. Displace A by 8% of frame width times sin(pi*p) in one direction and B in the opposite direction, blending by p, using the low-frequency noise map in <file>. Keep it in one paused timeline that seeks.

styles.name: 波浪叠化
styles.summary: 整幅画面周期性起伏弯曲，同时混合两个场景。
styles.prompt: Build a wave dissolve from <targetA> to <targetB>. Ramp progress p from 0 to 1 over 1 second with sine.inOut. Apply a vertical sine distortion with amplitude 3% of frame width times sin(pi*p) and phase 4*pi*p while mixing A and B by p. Use 3 waves, distortion 0 at both ends, and one paused timeline.

styles.name: 风吹擦除
styles.summary: 边缘每一行伸出不同长度，像风吹条纹一样换景。
styles.prompt: Build a wind wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. Split B into 40 horizontal strips; each slides in from the left over 0.4 seconds with a linear ease, with start delays spread across 0 to 0.2 seconds from fixed seeded values. Everything finishes within 0.6 seconds. No Math.random, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 锯齿擦除
styles.summary: 咬合的锯齿块边界移动，露出新的场景。
styles.prompt: Add a Zigzag Wipe to {script}. Build .next's clipPath as a polygon with 12 teeth, 96px deep, and move its boundary from x -96 to 1920 over 0.7s with linear ease. Write it as a function of p only so a paused timeline seeks to identical frames.

styles.name: 推进闪光
styles.summary: 画面快速放大，在最亮闪光中切到下一场景。
styles.prompt: Build a zoom flash transition from <targetA> to <targetB>. A scales to 3.2 with blur 4px and brightness 2.4 over 0.18 seconds (power3.in), a white flash rises at 0.12 seconds, B is swapped in at the peak, and B settles from scale 1.3 to 1 over 0.3 seconds (power3.out). One paused timeline.

styles.name: 推进擦除
styles.summary: 向中心推进时，一条直边扫过并露出新场景。
styles.prompt: Build a zoom wipe from <targetA> to <targetB>. A scales from 1 to 1.4 over 0.65 seconds while B scales from 1.4 to 1 and its clipPath inset opens from (0 100% 0 0) to (0 0% 0 0), revealing left to right. Both use power3.inOut, start together, and live in one paused timeline.

styles.name: 穿字窗口
styles.summary: 场景从字形镂空处可见，字孔长大直到铺满画面。

Hold 0.5 seconds, then scale the hole from 1 to 25 over 1.2 seconds with power3.inOut until the frame is completely filled with the next scene. Use a paused timeline so it can be seeked.

styles.name: 文字上下拆分
styles.summary: 一句话上下两半分开，新文字从两侧合拢。

Make two copies clipped at exactly 50% top and bottom; the old phrase splits 100% apart over 0.5 seconds and disappears, then 0.1 seconds later the new halves close in from the opposite directions in 0.5 seconds. styles.name: 静图推移

styles.summary: 背景朝相反方向移动，让镜头跟住运动主体。
styles.prompt: Apply Camera Follow to {script} in <file>. Shift the world to keep a subject at 60% of the viewport width when it crosses the 65% threshold; use 24px padding and a 600ms tween. Use power2.out and a paused GSAP core timeline that produces identical states when seeking backward.

styles.name: 绕物环拍
styles.summary: 镜头环绕居中主体，展示外形和背景关系。
styles.prompt: Apply Camera Orbit to {script} in <file>. Orbit 60 degrees over 2400ms at a 600px radius and 20-degree elevation while looking at the fixed center. Use power2.inOut and a paused GSAP core timeline that produces identical states when seeking backward.

styles.name: 撞击震镜
styles.summary: 冲击后整幅场景小幅平移旋转，震动逐渐减弱。

styles.summary: 镜头上下移动，同时改变观看角度。

Use a 700px Bodoni number {script} that fills the 1280px stage as an SVG clipPath window, with an editorial plate inside (grid, big number, serif title, bar diagram). styles.name: 长画布横移
styles.summary: 镜头连续横移穿过多块版面，最后停在焦点上。

Move the world wrapper from x 0 to −5,400px over 4.3 seconds with sine.inOut, starting at 0.2 seconds, then hold until 5 seconds. styles.name: 嵌套无限推进
styles.summary: 镜头连续钻入层层嵌套画面中的同一处焦点。

Use sibling plates and rebase the camera at integer stages: world scale=14^(p-floor(p)) and plate scale=14^(floor(p)-i), preserving continuous visible scale.

styles.name: 镜头畸变推进
styles.summary: 向中心推进时径向畸变先增强，再恢复为零。

styles.name: 透视倾斜
styles.summary: 整页向后倾斜露出版面网格，再回到正面。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Build a 1500×990px editorial page with a 3×3 figure grid and perspective 1400px. Starting at 0.3s, tilt to rotateX 55deg, scale 0.69 and z -180px over 1.45s. At 2.25s return to the center figure with rotateX 0deg, scale 2.02 and z 0 over 1.05s, then hold for 0.7s. styles.name: 屏幕短抖

Update every layer inside one draw(p) function that takes a single progress value p from 0 to 1, with beats enter 0 to 0.30, hold 0.30 to 0.75, exit 0.75 to 1. Reveal the title with a yPercent 110 to 0 mask between 0.02 and 0.27 and push it out upward between 0.76 and 0.90; gather three diagram parts from seeded scattered positions between 0.10 and 0.56 with power3.out, and draw the arrows between 0.44 and 0.70. Control everything with a single GSAP timeline and hold the completed state from 2.5 to 3 seconds.

Use these settings: probabilities 62·21·9·5·3%; duration 1.05s; stagger 0.08s; scale 10px/%; ease power2.out. Control everything with a single GSAP timeline and hold the completed state from 2.5 to 3 seconds.

Use these settings: target value 939; duration 1.65s; start 0.30s; unit reveal at 2.02s; ease power2.out. Control everything with a single GSAP timeline and hold the completed state from 2.5 to 3 seconds.

Use these settings: normalized path length 1; duration 1.85s; dot radius 8px; start 0.30s; ease none.
