styles.prompt: Update the {script} bar chart to the new data with GSAP. Match items by ID and reuse the existing elements, keep colors and labels unchanged, and tween y, height and the label y starting at 0.4s over 0.75s with power2.inOut. Do not delete and rebuild elements. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 分面合图
styles.summary: 多个小图中的标记移到同一坐标轴，或反向拆开。
styles.prompt: Add a Facet-to-Single Transition to {script}. Move the line marks of 3 panels (.mark-a, .mark-b, .mark-c) to the shared axis positions together over 1.1s with power3.inOut, keeping each item's color fixed. Fade out .panel-frame within 0.4s and fade in .common-axis from 0.5s over 0.4s. Use the same 0 to 100 axis range in both states.

styles.name: 鱼眼聚焦
styles.summary: 焦点附近的图形和刻度间距放大，周围区域被压缩。
styles.prompt: Apply Fisheye Lens to {script} in <file>. Blend original SVG coordinates with a bounded fisheye mapping over 800ms, using a 120px radius and strength 2; transform marks and ticks together. Use power1.inOut and a paused GSAP core timeline that produces identical states when seeking backward.

styles.name: 地图拔高
styles.summary: 城区或网格从地面升起，用高度显示密度。
styles.prompt: On the map in {script}, raise each district to a height proportional to its value. Tween the mesh scale.y from 0.001 to value*1 over 1.2 seconds with power3.out, staggering 30ms per district with the largest values first. Keep the camera fixed tilted at 45 degrees.

styles.name: 地图变柱图
styles.summary: 平面地图倾成高度图，区域立柱再排成条形图。
styles.prompt: Turn the map in {script} into a bar chart. From 0.3 seconds tilt the camera 45 degrees over 0.6s, then raise regional heights over 0.6s, then move the prisms to the bar baseline positions over 0.9s with power2.inOut. Keep each region's color to the end.

styles.name: 散点维度旋转
styles.summary: 散点向纵深散开、旋转，再聚成另一组变量的平面。
styles.prompt: Change the scatter plot in {script} from the X-Y plane to the X-Z plane. First expand the new variable along z for 0.4 seconds, rotate 90 degrees over 0.6 seconds, then compress onto the new plane in 0.4 seconds. Use orthographic projection and keep point colors.

styles.name: 图表分步变换
styles.summary: 坐标轴、位置和大小按不同阶段依次改变。
styles.prompt: Split the {script} chart transition into 3 stages with GSAP. At 0.3s change the axis over 0.4s, rest 0.12s, move the dots to new positions over 0.4s, rest another 0.12s, then change dot size over 0.4s. Ease power2.inOut and hold 0.6s after the last stage. Precompute data in dataset attributes and place everything at absolute times on one paused timeline.

styles.name: 倒计时滚字
styles.summary: 剩余天时分秒按固定间隔递减，数字逐位替换。
styles.prompt: Build a countdown ticker in {script}. Show remaining time as "DD days HH:MM:SS" in tabular-nums; each second the seconds digits swap from y 14px over 0.25s power2.out. State the target time small at the bottom and compute everything as a pure function of t, never from the current clock.

styles.name: 回答流式显示
styles.summary: 回答按词组陆续出现，每组新文字逐渐变实。
styles.prompt: Stream "AI reads the preceding words, assigns a probability to each possible next word, and then picks one." in the {script} answer as 10 span groups. Starting at 0.3 seconds, reveal one group every 0.18 seconds and increase its opacity from 0.22 to 1 over 0.26 seconds with ease none. Place a vermilion 15×34px cursor block at the end of the answer and hold still from 2.4 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 光标点击
styles.summary: 光标沿弧线移到按钮，用按下状态和波纹表示点击。
styles.prompt: Move the {script} cursor by x 740px, y -78px over 1.1 seconds starting at 0.3 seconds, using power2.inOut. Add -150*sin(π*t) to y to create a curved path. At 1.4 seconds, press the Send button to scale 0.94 over 0.12 seconds, then restore it over 0.22 seconds. Starting at 1.43 seconds, enlarge a vermilion ripple from scale 0.45 to 2.4 while fading it out over 0.65 seconds. Hold still from 2.32 seconds.

styles.name: 聚光区域
styles.summary: 周围屏幕变暗，重点区域保持清晰并用括号框住。
styles.prompt: Highlight the "picks 62%" region in the {script} candidate list with a spotlight. Keep the target element at opacity 1, and dim the title, question, and other candidates to opacity 0.25 over 0.65 seconds starting at 0.35 seconds. Starting at 0.7 seconds, draw vermilion 3px outline brackets over 0.45 seconds. Hold the completed state from 1.65 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 输入打字
styles.summary: 问题以不规则间隔逐字输入，末端光标持续闪烁。
styles.prompt: Reveal "How do you pick the next word?" in the {script} input field using character spans starting after 0.3 seconds. Fix the intervals at [0.08,0.11,0.07,0.14,0.09,0.12,0.17,0.08,0.10,0.07,0.15,0.09,0.11,0.13,0.10] seconds and blink the caret every 0.24 seconds. From 2.4 seconds, keep the caret visible and hold the completed sentence until 3 seconds.

styles.name: 文档滚动
styles.summary: 长文平滑向上移动，到指定段落停住并用竖线标记。
styles.prompt: Set the {script} document viewport to 820×390px and scroll the inner document to y -555px over 1.55 seconds starting at 0.3 seconds with power3.inOut. Once the target paragraph is aligned 30px inside the viewport, reveal a vermilion 4×125px vertical line by changing scaleY from 0 to 1 over 0.3 seconds starting at 1.9 seconds. Hold the completed state from 2.4 to 3 seconds.

styles.name: 放大标注
styles.summary: 小数值在旁边圆形窗口里放大，两处用线连接。
styles.prompt: Enlarge "picks 62%" from the candidate list in {script} in a circular magnifier on the right. Use 23px text for the original, 104px for the enlarged value, and a circle diameter of 330px. Starting at 0.65 seconds, animate from x -120px, scale 0.25, opacity 0 to x 0, scale 1, opacity 1 over 0.85 seconds with power3.out. Connect the two locations with a thin line drawn over 0.65 seconds.

styles.name: 角色回应输入

For CSS animation, implement seeking with a paused play state and a negative delay.

styles.prompt: Apply Hold to Confirm to {script} in <file>. A button fills while held and switches to a completion mark. Use a 1.2-second duration, a 200ms completion pop, and power2.out easing. Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state.

Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state. For CSS animation, implement seeking with a paused play state and a negative delay.

Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state.

Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state. Redraw the canvas from the same progress value on each frame; use the DOM layers in the core snippet as a compositing reference.

Exit a removed item over 250ms before measuring the remaining layout. Define the initial state and use a paused timeline with fixed coordinates and timings for repeatable seeking.

Use a 0.5-second duration, 16px maximum displacement, and power2.out easing. Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state.

styles.summary: 数据点不动，连线在直线与曲线之间来回变化。
styles.prompt: Implement Line Tension Loop on {script}. Use one-way duration 1s; minimum tension 0; maximum tension 1; round-trip period 2s; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 网格扭曲
styles.summary: 控制点移动，让整张平面图像像布一样弯曲。
styles.prompt: Use WebGL and GSAP to add a 6x6 mesh warp to <image>. Move each control point in a wave with a 0.3 rad phase step, up to 24px in x and y, and multiply displacement by sin(t*PI) so it returns exactly to 0 at start and end. Tween t from 0 to 1 starting at 0.3 seconds over 0.9 seconds with sine.inOut, and warp the texture with it. Paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 轮廓偏移
styles.summary: 图形轮廓以固定距离向外扩大或向内缩小。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP and SVG to animate an outline offset on <shape>. Precompute the path d at offsets 0, 8, 16 and 24px, and step through them from 0.3 seconds over 0.6 seconds with power2.inOut so it swells evenly. Do not scale; keep stroke width and corner shape. For a circle, tweening r by 24px is fine. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 先描边后填色
styles.summary: 轮廓或线框先出现，内部表面随后填色。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to reveal <SVG> as outline then fill. Draw the 2px stroke with stroke-dashoffset over 0.7 seconds with power2.out, then from 0.65 seconds raise fill-opacity from 0 to 1 over 0.4 seconds. If there are several shapes, offset each by 0.12 seconds, and keep the outline after the fill. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 路径局部高亮
styles.summary: 一小段亮线沿完整路径游走。
styles.prompt: Add a bright travelling segment along the {script} line with GSAP. Set pathLength=1, strokeDasharray '0.15 0.85', stroke width 5px, a bright color, and from 0.4s over 0.9s animate strokeDashoffset from 0.15 to -1 linearly. Keep the base line dark gray. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 齿孔撕裂
styles.summary: 票据一端沿齿孔撕开落下，主体仍留在原位。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to tear the right stub off <ticket> along its perforation. At 0.3 seconds shake it x 4px four times at 0.08 seconds each, from 0.6 seconds move it x 80px, y 40px, rotation 20 degrees over 0.8 seconds with power2.out, then fade opacity to 0 over 0.3 seconds from 1.2 seconds. Keep the dotted perforation visible and the body still.

styles.name: 旋转支点接力
styles.summary: 元素先绕一个角旋转，再换到另一个角，最后停稳。
styles.prompt: Add a pivot relay to <card> with GSAP. The outer wrapper rotates 8 degrees around its top-left corner from 0.3 seconds for 0.5 seconds; the inner wrapper rotates -3 degrees around its bottom-right corner from 0.8 seconds for 0.5 seconds. Ease power2.inOut. No visible jump when the pivot changes. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 收缩鼓胀
styles.summary: 顶点和曲线被反向拉动，图形变成星形或花形。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP and SVG to pucker <circle> into a star. On a 100 radius circle with 16 points, move even points outward and odd points inward by amount, and grow amount from 0 to 0.35 starting at 0.3 seconds over 0.7 seconds with power2.inOut into a pointed star. Fixed point count, no self intersection, paused timeline.

styles.name: 圆角变化
styles.summary: 尖角逐渐变圆，或从圆角恢复尖角。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to round the corners of <shape>. From 0.4 seconds over 0.5 seconds, raise borderRadius from 0 to 24px with power2.inOut, staggering by 60ms if there are several shapes. Do not exceed 50% of the short side, and leave size and position unchanged. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 图形重复器
styles.summary: 同一图形按固定的位置、角度和大小差不断复制。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to unfurl 12 copies of <SVG shape> into a spiral. All copies start stacked; from 0.2 seconds, staggered by i*30ms, each moves over 0.8 seconds with power3.out to x i*24px, rotation i*30 degrees, scale 0.94^i. Create the copies statically at load, no Math.random, paused timeline.

styles.name: 图形分合
styles.summary: 一个形状分成多个小形状，或多个形状合成一个。
styles.prompt: Animate a circle in {script} splitting into 3 pieces using SVG paths. Divide the original into three sectors resampled to 100 points and spread each 36px apart over 1.6 seconds with power3.inOut. The pieces start inside the circle and must sum to the original circle.

styles.name: 斜切变形
styles.summary: 图形沿一个轴倾斜，表现受力和速度。
styles.prompt: Add a skew to the {script} title with GSAP. From 0.3s enter from x -120px over 0.35s with power3.out, and at 0.45s return skewX from -4 to 0 degrees over 0.2s with power2.out. It must end at skew 0. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 软体晃动
styles.summary: 软物体随移动和碰撞被压扁晃动，再恢复圆润形状。
styles.prompt: Add soft body jiggle to the blob in {script} on a canvas. 18 boundary points, stiffness 120/s^2, damping 15/s, integrated at a fixed 1/60 second step. The center moves 120px in x at 0.3 seconds, then wobbles for 2.5 seconds and returns to a circle. Draw it as a closed curve.

styles.name: 标志分合
styles.summary: 一个标记向两侧分开，中间露出短语，再合拢。
styles.prompt: Use a GSAP timeline to split <logo> into left and right halves and open then close it. At 0.5 seconds move each half +/-120px over 0.4 seconds with power3.out, and at 0.7 seconds fade {script} in between over 0.3 seconds. Hold 1.0 second, then at 1.9 seconds close over 0.3 seconds with power3.in and fade the phrase out. The logo must return exactly to its start position.

styles.name: 渐细笔触
styles.summary: 线条伸缩时，起点和末端像毛笔笔锋一样变细。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP and SVG to draw a tapered stroke along <curve>. Build a filled path from sampled points with width profile W*sin(pi*u), max 12px and 0px at both ends, and draw it from progress 0 to 1 starting at 0.3 seconds over 0.9 seconds with power2.out. From 1.6 seconds erase it tail first over 0.4 seconds. Smooth width change, paused timeline.

styles.name: 变形波传播
styles.summary: 弯曲从物体一侧传到另一侧，经过后恢复原状。
styles.prompt: Add a traveling deformation wave to the line in {script}. Displace 40 points in y with a sine of amplitude 12px and wavelength 60% of the width, traveling left to right over 1 second, with a cosine envelope so both ends have zero displacement. It must end perfectly straight.

styles.name: 锯齿路径
styles.summary: 平滑轮廓逐渐长出重复尖角或波纹。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP and SVG to add a zigzag to the outline of <circle>. Sample the perimeter at 48 points, alternate them +a and -a along the normal, and grow a from 0 to 12px starting at 0.3 seconds over 0.7 seconds with power2.out. Fixed point count, angular teeth, then hold. Amplitude at most 15% of the radius, paused timeline.

styles.name: 几何拼字
styles.summary: 线条和几何小块滑到一起，拼成字的笔画与装饰。
styles.prompt: Build the word '{script}' in {script} from 3 to 5 SVG shapes per letter (circles, bars, half circles) that fly in from fixed off-screen positions and assemble the letters. 0.8 seconds per piece, 50ms apart, back.out(1.4); 0.4 seconds after completion remove decoration pieces over 0.3 seconds. Use fixed start values and one paused timeline that can be seeked.

styles.name: 沿路径排字
styles.summary: 字符沿弯曲路径排列并移动。
styles.prompt: In {script} draw a gentle S-shaped SVG path and place '{script}' on it as a textPath so startOffset runs from -60% to 5% over 2 seconds. Font size 56px, ease none, hold 1.5 seconds after arrival. Keep the curve radius at least 4 times the font size and use one paused timeline.

styles.name: 数字雨
styles.summary: 一列列字符从顶部落下，明亮头部后拖着渐暗尾巴。
styles.prompt: Build a digital rain background behind {script} on a canvas. Use a 16px column pitch, a per-column fall speed of 60 to 180px/s, a white head, a 12-character tail fading from green to transparent, and characters that change every 80ms. Run 6 seconds total and use seeded randomness so seeking gives identical frames.

styles.name: 边缘反光
styles.summary: 物体转动时边缘发亮，柔和光泽扫过表面。
styles.prompt: Add a Fresnel rim to {script} (a sphere or logo mesh). Rotate it at 20 deg/s for 5 seconds. Use a dot(N,V) rim with exponent 3 and intensity 0.7 in a cool white, hugging only the edges, over a dark flat background. Drive the uniforms from one GSAP timeline so seeking gives identical frames.

styles.name: 鼓包透镜
styles.summary: 透明镜片扫过图像，只放大隆起正下方的区域。
styles.prompt: Add a bulge lens over {script}. Radius 15% of the frame width, refraction strength 0.05, moving from 15% to 85% of the width over 3 seconds with sine.inOut. Soften the rim with smoothstep and drive it with a single progress uniform in a WebGL shader so a paused timeline can seek it.

styles.name: 焦散水纹
styles.summary: 亮线织成的光网漂移聚散，像水下折射。
styles.prompt: Lay caustic ripples under {script} in WebGL. Pattern scale 4, speed 0.25/s, brightness 0.6, line width 0.02 UV, teal monochrome, 6 seconds. Drive uTime only from a timeline tween and keep the foreground card readable.

styles.name: 显像管扫描线
styles.summary: 细扫描线、轻微弯曲和亮带让画面像老显示器。
styles.prompt: Overlay a CRT scanline effect on {script}. Use 3px-spaced black horizontal lines at opacity 0.18, curvature 0.02, vignette 0.35, and a 0.06-brightness scan band moving top to bottom at 60px/s. Keep the post layer pointer-events none and drive time only from paused timeline progress.

styles.name: 胶片颗粒
styles.summary: 细颗粒以低帧率更新，给画面带来胶片纹理。
styles.prompt: Add film grain over all of {script}. Build eight 256px noise tiles with a fixed seed, overlay them with mix-blend-mode overlay at opacity 0.08 and 1.5px grain, and cycle the tiles at 12fps. Choose the tile as a pure function of timeline time, no Math.random. Keep the layer pointer-events none.

styles.name: 玻璃折射
styles.summary: 玻璃板模糊折射后方背景，移动时带起波动。
styles.prompt: Turn <panel> into glass and move it 640px right. Use backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(1.3), white fill at opacity 0.12, a 1px border at opacity 0.35, radius 28px. Move over 1.5s with power3.inOut, and ramp feDisplacementMap scale from 0 to 6px and back to 0 during the move. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 故障分色
styles.summary: 颜色通道和横切片短暂抖开，再跳回原画面。
styles.prompt: Add an RGB split glitch to the title in {script}. Stack a red copy and a blue copy over the original with mix-blend-mode screen at opacity 0.35. For 0.3s at 24fps steps, jitter red by -12px and blue by +12px and offset six horizontal clip-path slices. Remove both copies at the end. Seeded randomness only, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 体积光束
styles.summary: 多束光从光源扇形散开，缓慢摆动并变换亮度。
styles.prompt: Add god rays to the background of {script}. Twelve beams fan out over a 50 degree spread from a source above the frame center at (50%, -10%), fading with exp(-1.6d). Brightness pulses with a sine of amplitude 0.3 over a 6-second loop and the angles sway slightly. Brightest behind the product image, with opacity held under 0.25 over text.

styles.name: 全息彩光
styles.summary: 卡片角度变化时，一道彩虹光泽滑过表面。
styles.prompt: Add a holographic sheen to <card>. Build a rainbow hue band with WebGL or a CSS conic-gradient and sweep a 25-degree diagonal band from left to right once over 3s. Hue speed 0.15, Fresnel strength 0.4, and tilt the card rotateY from -10 to 10 degrees with sine.inOut. Keep sheen brightness over text at 0.3 or lower and drive it from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 舞台灯展开
styles.summary: 两侧上方光锥变宽，像舞台灯一样照出中线。
styles.prompt: Add a lamp cone reveal to the dark screen of {script}. Two conic-gradient light cones spread from the top center to each side, width 0 to 600px over 1 second with power3.out and a fixed 40px blur. At 0.35 seconds the title rises 20px into place. Hold for 1.5 seconds afterwards.

styles.name: 胶片漏光
styles.summary: 大块暖色光斑漂过画面后淡出。
styles.prompt: Add a light leak transition to {script}. Overlay three oversized radial-gradient layers (orange, red, yellow) with mix-blend-mode screen. Move them from off-screen left to the right over 0.7s while opacity rises from 0 to 0.35 and back. Stagger layers by 0.06s, ease sine.inOut, and peak exactly on the cut. Use one paused GSAP timeline that can be seeked.

styles.name: 液态金属
styles.summary: 银色表面黏稠流动，镜面倒影持续变化。
styles.prompt: Add a liquid metal effect to the surface behind the logo in {script}. Build a silver surface with fbm-noise normals, deformation 0.2, speed 0.25, contrast 1.5, mapping reflections from light gray to dark navy. Flow steadily over 7 seconds as a loop and raise reflection strength by 20% inside the logo mask.

styles.name: 色板循环
styles.summary: 像素位置不变，颜色映射轮换，像水或光在流动。
styles.prompt: Apply palette cycling to {script} (a pixel art or indexed color image). Rotate 8 palette slots by one step every 120ms for 4 seconds, excluding outline pixels. Compute the offset as Math.floor(progress * 33) so seeking gives identical frames.

styles.name: 粒子视频马赛克
styles.summary: 固定圆点网格逐帧取视频颜色，用点重画运动场景。
styles.prompt: Redraw the video in {script} as a dot grid with 5px pitch. Each dot is a 2px circle whose color is sampled from the source frame, over 4 seconds. Keep the video paused and set currentTime from timeline progress so seeking gives identical frames.

styles.name: 像素排序
styles.summary: 像素按亮度拉成长条，形成横向或纵向故障纹路。
styles.prompt: Add a pixel-sort effect to <image>. In a WebGL fragment shader, for each 8px-wide vertical stripe, push only pixels with brightness above 0.55 downward in proportion to brightness, up to 60px. Ramp progress from 0 to 1 over 0.6s with power2.in, then cross-fade to the next image over 0.15s. Deterministic, no randomness, seekable via a paused timeline.

styles.name: 丝绸流动
styles.summary: 亮滑布料褶皱缓慢漂移，明暗顺着褶皱流动。
styles.prompt: Add a silk flow to the background of {script}. Deep purple base with directional-noise folds at frequency 8, speed 0.2, contrast 0.4, and a bright highlight on the fold crests. Flow at constant speed (ease none) over 8 seconds, and lower the contrast in the right 40% where the product image sits. Drive time with a single paused-timeline value.

styles.name: 等高线流动
styles.summary: 密集等高线沿变形表面铺开，高度和颜色缓慢变化。
styles.prompt: Add a topographic contour flow to the background of {script}. Draw 1.5 px white lines at 0.3 opacity on dark navy, contour gap 0.08, deformation amplitude 0.2, looping every 6 seconds. Tint only the peaks teal and keep contrast in the center where the title sits. Drive time with one phase value on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 录像带跟踪
styles.summary: 横向扭曲带和颜色毛边上扫，像录像带跟踪错误。
styles.prompt: Add a VHS tracking glitch to {script}. Slice the frame into 20 rows of 54px, and sweep a distortion band from bottom to top over 0.6s. Rows inside the band shift horizontally by a fixed sin-based value up to +/-14px, with red and blue copies at opacity 0.35. Ease power1.inOut, reset all rows to zero at the end. One paused timeline, seekable.

styles.name: 动态抖色
styles.summary: 有限颜色配规则点纹，色阶随时间变化。
styles.prompt: Add animated dithering to <image>. Use a Bayer 8x8 threshold map at 2px cells, starting in 2 colors (black and white) and stepping through 2, 4, 8, and 16 color levels over 1.2s with steps(4) so it approaches the original. Keep the threshold map fixed and never change it per frame. Drive uProg from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 字符画动画
styles.summary: 图像变成按亮度排列的字符网格，收紧后还原原图。
styles.prompt: Turn <image> into an ASCII character display and resolve it to the original. Start on a 24px grid and tighten to 6px over 1.5s with power2.inOut, using a 10-step ramp ' .:-=+*#%@' in a bold monospace font. Cross-fade to the original over the last 0.3s. Draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 桶形畸变
styles.summary: 边缘直线弯曲，整幅图像像广角镜头一样鼓起。
styles.prompt: Add a barrel warp to {script}. Starting at 0.2 seconds, raise the distortion coefficient from 0 to 0.18 over 1.6 seconds with power3.inOut. Convert UVs with p=uv-0.5, q=p*(1+k*dot(p,p))/1.08 so the zoom correction prevents edge cropping, and keep text within the central 60 percent so it stays readable.

styles.name: 辉光脉冲
styles.summary: 亮物体周围的柔光先扩散，再收拢。
styles.prompt: Add a bloom pulse to {script} with GSAP. From 0.4s ease a filter drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(120,190,255,0.95)) in over 0.8s with sine.inOut and back to none over 0.8s with the same curve. Keep intensity at 0.6 or less over text. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 压缩块故障
styles.summary: 压缩块和扭曲颜色沿运动方向拖开，随后恢复。
styles.prompt: Add a codec glitch to <video>. On a canvas, build a 24px block grid, shift 35% of blocks (chosen by a seeded hash) along x by up to 80px, and restore the shift to 0 over 700ms with power2.out. Shift the hue of some blocks by +/-20 degrees. Draw as a pure function of progress with seeded randomness.

styles.name: 胶片灰尘划痕
styles.summary: 细尘点和竖划痕出现在画面上，移位后消失。
styles.prompt: Overlay film dust and scratches on <video>. On a canvas at 12fps, use a frame-index-seeded random (mulberry) to reposition 20 dust specks (radius 1-4px, max opacity 0.15) every frame, and with 50% chance show 1-2 vertical scratches for 1-3 frames. Do not use Math.random.

styles.name: 火焰噪声循环
styles.summary: 火焰状噪声在光源或虹膜周围闪动，中心孔随视线移动。
styles.prompt: Add a flame noise loop at the center of {script}. Map a 200px-radius ring from orange (#ff7a1a) to pale yellow (#ffd27a) and ripple its edge with polar fbm noise at strength 0.2. Loop seamlessly every 4 seconds, and shift the black pupil 12px right at 0.4 seconds and 8px left at 2 seconds with sine.inOut.

styles.name: 流向拖抹
styles.summary: 图像顺运动方向弯曲拖开，过一会儿恢复。
styles.prompt: Add a flowmap smear to the image in {script}. A virtual cursor moves from (300,540) to (1500,540) over 1 second; within a 120px radius along the path the image is pushed up to 20px in the direction of motion, then recovers to rest over 0.9 seconds with power2.out. Define the cursor path as timeline keyframes and do not use live input.

styles.name: 条纹玻璃
styles.summary: 重复竖向玻璃棱横移，把背景拉长折叠。
styles.prompt: Add a fluted glass effect to the background of {script}. Divide the frame into 18 vertical flutes, shift the UV sideways by 0.025 times the in-flute position n (-1 to 1) to refract, and darken toward flute edges by n^2*0.2. The pattern drifts sideways at 0.04UV per second over 5 seconds. Keep panel text outside the effect.

styles.name: 胶片机械晃动
styles.summary: 影像轻微机械错位，曝光也略微明暗变化。
styles.prompt: Add gate weave to <video layer>. Cycle a fixed-seed offset table (within +/-1.3px) at 12fps for x and y, and oscillate brightness between 1.0 and 1.03 on a 1.2s sine.inOut cycle. Keep captions and UI outside the weave and do not use Math.random. Use a paused timeline so it is seekable.

styles.name: 故障扫描带
styles.summary: 窄斜带扫过文字，只有带内出现颜色错位。
styles.prompt: Add a scan glitch band to {script}. Pass a band 15% wide at a 20-degree slant from off-screen left to off-screen right over 0.8s with power1.inOut. Only inside the band, shift the red copy -8px and the blue copy +8px and raise brightness by 0.15. Text outside stays untouched. Remove the copies afterward. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 排线填充
styles.summary: 锯齿笔迹在形状内部往返，把它像手涂一样填满。
styles.prompt: Add a hatch fill to the shape in {script}. Draw a 45 degree zigzag path over the shape's bounding box with 6px spacing, 2px stroke, color #e8590c, and clip it to the shape. Reduce stroke-dashoffset from full length to 0 over 1.2 seconds with power1.inOut, starting at 0.2 seconds, so it fills from top to bottom.

styles.name: 墨迹渗开
styles.summary: 墨块在纸上晕开融合，再收缩成清楚的字或标记。
styles.prompt: Make {script} appear as bleeding ink. With an SVG filter, reduce feGaussianBlur stdDeviation from 16 to 0 over 1.2s with power2.inOut, then threshold with feColorMatrix alpha slope 24 and offset -12 to form a liquid edge. Ink #1a1a1f on paper #f2ede2 with a fixed-seed feTurbulence grain. Blur must be 0 at the last frame.

styles.name: 万花筒
styles.summary: 图像镜像成对称纹样，中心旋转让图案持续变化。
styles.prompt: Add a kaleidoscope to the image in {script}. Start at symmetry 1 and expand to 6 over 0.6 seconds with power2.out, while rotating 60 degrees linearly over 3 seconds. Source sampling zoom 1.4, folding sectors around the center (960,540) and sampling with reflected UVs. Hold for 0.5 seconds at the end.

styles.name: 镜头光斑
styles.summary: 亮点伸出蓝紫横光，后面跟着小圆形反射光斑。
styles.prompt: Add a lens flare at the bright point at the upper right of <logo>. Overlay a horizontal streak (480px long, 6px tall, blue-violet #7a8aff to white gradient) with mix-blend-mode screen, scaleX 0 to 1 over 0.6s with expo.out, then fade out over 0.5s. Place three small reflection circles opposite the source. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 字内扫光
styles.summary: 斜光带扫过大字内部，像金属印刷的反光。
styles.prompt: Add a light sweep to {script} (a big number and title) in <file>. Duplicate the text layer with color transparent and background-clip:text, using a 112deg gradient (transparent 45.5%, --ink2 47.8%, --paper 50%, --ink2 52.2%, transparent 54.5%) and background-size 250%. Tween backgroundPosition from 96.4% to 3.6% over 1.5s with power1.inOut, once. After the light passes, draw a vermilion underline under the key word in 0.5s with power3.out and hold for at least 0.6s.

styles.name: 线条沸腾
styles.summary: 手绘线条以低帧率轻轻抖动。
styles.prompt: Add line boil to <diagram>. Apply SVG feTurbulence (baseFrequency 0.02) and feDisplacementMap (scale 3) to line elements only, cycling seed through 1, 7, 13, 29 at 5fps so lines jitter about +/-1px. Exclude filled shapes and text. Use tl.set steps on a paused timeline so it is seekable.

styles.name: 运动模糊
styles.summary: 沿运动方向叠合多个画面，让快速物体带拖影。
styles.prompt: Add motion blur to {script} as it enters from the left over 1400px. Move over 0.35s with expo.out and apply blur only along the motion direction, proportional to speed up to 20px, and 0 at rest. Compute speed from the ease derivative or a small time delta so seeking a paused timeline gives identical results.

styles.name: 移动光源
styles.summary: 光源移动，物体亮面与阴影方向一起变化。
styles.prompt: Add a moving light to <card>. A radial-gradient light (radius 45%, brightness 0.45) moves from x -20% to 120% over 2s with sine.inOut, and the box-shadow shifts (50-x)*0.4px in the opposite direction with a fixed 24px y offset and 40px blur. Tween the CSS variable --lx with GSAP on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 正负形反转
styles.summary: 轮廓保持不变，亮色形体和暗色空白互换。
styles.prompt: Build a negative space inversion for {script} where the silhouette stays put and the colors swap roles. Tween the background from #fff to #111 and the silhouette fill from #111 to #fff over 0.5 seconds with power2.inOut. Do not change the path coordinates, and reveal B's content inside the silhouette afterward. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 粒子笔触绘画
styles.summary: 带图像颜色的短笔触沿流场移动，把画面散成绘画。
styles.prompt: Add particle painting to the image in {script}. 3000 brush marks placed on a fixed grid carry the image colors at their home positions, move along an fbm flow field at 12px per second for 5 seconds as 8px by 2px rectangles rotated to the flow direction, then return home starting at 3.8 seconds over 1.2 seconds with sine.inOut so the original image is restored.

styles.name: 极坐标卷绕
styles.summary: 横排图像卷成圆环，或从圆环展开回平面。
styles.prompt: Add a polar wrap to the horizontal strip in {script}. The 12-cell color strip starts at 0.3 seconds and rolls over 1 second with power2.inOut into a circular band with inner radius 120px and outer radius 360px. Handle it with one mix value between Cartesian and polar UVs and pin the wrap seam at 12 o'clock.

styles.name: 边缘渐进模糊
styles.summary: 越靠近内容边缘越模糊，让移动内容平滑消失。
styles.prompt: Add a progressive blur to the bottom edge of the scroll area in {script}. Split a 120px band into 5 backdrop-filter layers so blur grows from 0 to 12px, and join the layers with linear-gradient masks. The overlay appears over 0.6 seconds with power2.out and cards scrolling through it fade out smoothly.

styles.name: 雨滴玻璃
styles.summary: 玻璃雨滴放大内部背景，水滴合并后往下流。
styles.prompt: Add a raindrop glass effect to the background image in {script}. Presimulate 80 drops from seed 12 with radius 3 to 14px, where larger drops run down at 15 to 80px per second and absorb small drops they pass. Inside each drop the background is refracted and inverted at 0.03UV; outside it is slightly blurred (2px). Play 6 seconds.

styles.name: 涟漪扭曲
styles.summary: 圆形波纹掠过屏幕，短暂改变周围颜色和形状。
styles.prompt: Add a ripple distortion to <screen>. In a WebGL fragment shader, expand a wavefront from the click point at 0.5 UV/s, with a sine ring of 0.05 UV wavelength decaying by exp(-2.5t), displacing sample coordinates by up to 0.02 UV. Duration 1.4s, displacement 0 at the end. Drive uTime from a paused timeline and use a fixed click coordinate.

styles.name: 狭缝扫描
styles.summary: 每行或每列取自不同时刻，让图像像波浪一样拉弯。
styles.prompt: Add a slit-scan effect to <image>. On a canvas, shift each row y in x by sin(y*0.02+t), with amplitude decaying from 60px to 0 over 1.2s using power2.out so it returns to the original. Give rows a phase lag from top to bottom of about 2ms each. No randomness; draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 频闪画面
styles.summary: 颜色或纹理按短拍点反复切换，最后停住。
styles.prompt: Build a strobe swap effect from <four sources>. Cycle them in fixed order at 100ms intervals and land on the final image at 1.2s. Set opacity with tl.set, hold the final image for at least 0.5s, never show more than 3 white frames in a row, and do not use Math.random. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 时间抖动
styles.summary: 播放时间混入噪声，速度不规则地忽快忽慢。
styles.prompt: Add a temporal wiggle to the motion of {script}. Keep the 2-second constant-speed move as a paused tween and play it with time(t + w(t)), where w is a sum of two sine waves (2 Hz and 3.3 Hz, phases 11 and 4) with 80 ms amplitude. The move should hitch slightly and catch up. Clamp time to 0 to 2 seconds.

styles.name: 文字光射线
styles.summary: 彩边光线从字形伸出，指向移动光点。
styles.prompt: Add light rays streaming from the letters of {script}. Draw the text mask on an offscreen canvas and accumulate 48 scaled samples toward a light point at the upper right for 300px rays with screen blending. Ramp intensity 0 to 0.4 then settle to 0.1 over 3s. Chromatic split 3px, and redraw the crisp letter body above the rays. Pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 纹理填充运动
styles.summary: 固定形状遮罩内，纹理移动或逐帧替换。
styles.prompt: Make a texture flow inside the letters of {script}. Use font-weight 800 at 220px with background-clip text and a sunset texture image at background-size 150%, and move background-position-x from 0 to -320px over 2s, linear. Keep the outline fixed and lower texture contrast so the text stays readable. Drive it from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 湍流位移
styles.summary: 像素和轮廓顺不规则流动纹样晃动，再恢复。
styles.prompt: Add turbulent displacement to <image>. Use SVG feTurbulence (baseFrequency 0.008 0.012, seed 3) with feDisplacementMap, raising scale from 0 to 4px over 0.6s with sine.inOut. Slowly shift baseFrequency linearly over 3s and drop scale to 0 in the last 0.5s to restore. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 中心扭转
styles.summary: 中心周围影像像漩涡一样旋转卷曲。
styles.prompt: Add a twirl distortion to the image in {script}. Centered on (960,540) with radius 160px, rotate up to 180 degrees over 1 second with power2.inOut starting at 0.2 seconds, more at the center (k = smoothstep squared). From 1.4 seconds unwind back over 0.6 seconds with power2.out.

styles.name: 速度斜切
styles.summary: 滚动越快，文字和卡片越歪，停下后恢复。
styles.prompt: Add velocity skew to <card>. Multiply the time derivative of scroll progress (speed) by 0.02 deg/(px/s), clamp skewY to +/-12 degrees, and ease toward the target by 30% each frame. When scrolling stops, return to 0 degrees over 300ms with power3.out. Apply only to titles and cards, not body text.

styles.name: 水面折射
styles.summary: 图像在水波下晃动，明亮波面掠过其上。
styles.prompt: Add water refraction to the image in {script}. Build the surface height from two sines (wavelengths 0.12UV and 0.17UV, traveling at 0.1UV and 0.07UV per second) and refract the UV by the slope at 0.02. Add a highlight at strength 0.25 where the slope faces the light. Play at constant speed for 6 seconds.

styles.name: 波浪扭曲
styles.summary: 句子位置不变，字形轮廓像正弦波一样弯曲。
styles.prompt: Add a wave warp to {script}. Use SVG feTurbulence (baseFrequency 0.012 0, seed 2) with feDisplacementMap to ripple the outlines at 4px amplitude and about 80px wavelength, shifting phase over 1.8s. Raise amplitude in the first 0.4s and restore it to 0 in the last 0.4s with sine.inOut. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 黏液文字形变
styles.summary: 一个词融成液团，再组成下一个词。
styles.prompt: Morph word A into word B in {script} like liquid. Apply SVG feGaussianBlur plus feColorMatrix (alpha 18 -7) only on the container; over 1.0s drive blur as sin(p*PI)*12px while A fades 1 to 0 and B 0 to 1. Hold each word 0.8s.

styles.name: 霓虹牌闪烁
styles.summary: 发光招牌的亮度和光晕不规则地亮起熄灭。
styles.prompt: Make the title '{script}' in {script} light up like a neon sign. Over 2 seconds flicker through the fixed brightness array [0,1,0,0.6,0,1,0.3,1,0.5,1] at 0.2 second steps, with a two-layer text-shadow glow (16px, 40px) proportional to brightness. It settles at brightness 1 and never flickers again. No random values.

styles.name: 文字回声拖尾
styles.summary: 移动短语后面跟着延迟副本，逐渐淡出。
styles.prompt: As the title in {script} slides in from 900px left over 0.9s power3.out, add 6 trailing copies each starting 0.045s later, at opacity 0.5 decaying with index. Remove all copies at 1.3s so only one title remains.

styles.name: 液态文字扭曲
styles.summary: 文字笔画的边缘和内部随噪声弯曲起波。
styles.prompt: Add a liquid distortion to the title in {script}. Render the text to a canvas texture and displace UVs with noise, easing amplitude from 0.15 to 0 over 0.8s power2.out. Noise speed 0.5, seed fixed at 0.4, read uTime from the timeline so seeking reproduces frames.

styles.name: 文字条带错位
styles.summary: 文字被平行条带分开，交替向两侧移位。
styles.prompt: Add a slice offset to the title in {script}. Duplicate the text into 8 horizontal strips (clip-path inset); at 0.3s odd strips start at +12px and even strips at -12px and return to 0 over 0.2s power4.out. Keep the rest of the time still and readable.

styles.name: 追寻抵达
styles.summary: 物体转向目标，靠近时逐渐减速。
styles.prompt: Implement seek and arrive for {script} in <file>. Place the target 120px to the right of the starting point and use 1.8 seconds, a maximum speed of 120px/s, a slowing radius of 90px, and a maximum acceleration of 220px/s². Recompute from the initial state at fixed 1/120-second steps, drive playback with a paused GSAP timeline, and pin the agent to the target at the end.

styles.name: 文字粒子消散
styles.summary: 文字提交后碎成细小粒子，逐渐淡去。
styles.prompt: Apply Text Particle Dissolve to {script} in <file>. Text breaks into small particles and fades after submission. Use a 0.9-second duration, 200 particles, and power2.out easing. Implement the core snippet with selectors matching the target, using a deterministic paused timeline, and retain the final state. Redraw the canvas from the same progress value on each frame; use the DOM layers in the core snippet as a compositing reference.

styles.name: 噪声域扭曲
styles.summary: 噪声叠加扭曲噪声，形成不断流动的有机背景。
styles.prompt: Add a domain-warping shader background to {script}. In a WebGL fragment shader, warp 5-octave FBM noise with itself twice (warp strength 4.0), driving uTime as progress x 5s x 0.4. Mix three colors (navy, teal, near-white) and keep luminance range behind text at or below 0.25. Make it loop cleanly at 5s and avoid Date.now and Math.random.

styles.name: 水中流墨
styles.summary: 彩色墨水在水中扩散旋转，柔和地混合。
styles.prompt: Add a fluid ink effect to the background of {script}. Two colors, teal (#22d3ee) and magenta (#e879f9), swirl and blend through domain warping over 8 seconds, with swirl size around 120px and speed 0.2. Use only two colors and soften edges with smoothstep. Draw as a pure function of t instead of simulating, so it can seek.

styles.name: 分形云团
styles.summary: 柔软云团缓慢漂移并改变形状。
styles.prompt: Add a fractal cloud background behind {script}. On a pale sky-blue base, draw 6 cloud masses with 5-octave fbm, drifting horizontally at 10px per second and slowly changing shape over 16 seconds. Keep cloud contrast at 0.3 or lower and drive time with a single t on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 神经纹路噪声
styles.summary: 细亮线和沟槽不断折叠铺开，像神经或血管网络。
styles.prompt: Build a neuro noise background behind {script} in WebGL. Scale 3, line width 0.03 UV, time speed 0.2/s, contrast 0.75, teal lines on a deep navy base, 6 seconds. Drive uTime from a single GSAP timeline tween.

styles.name: 粒子爆发
styles.summary: 粒子从一点向外炸开，受重力下落并淡出。
styles.prompt: Add a particle burst to {script} at the moment it appears. On a canvas, launch 80 particles from the origin evenly over 360 degrees at 240-620px/s, gravity 600px/s^2, lifetime 1.2s with the last 0.3s fading, size 4-9px shrinking to 0.4x. Use a fixed seed so trajectories repeat, and draw positions as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 粒子成像
styles.summary: 散开的粒子聚成图像的形状和颜色。
styles.prompt: Build a particle reveal for <image>. Sample it on a 3px grid into 1000 particles carrying the target pixel color, starting at seeded random positions outside a 900px radius. Converge over 2s with power3.out, arrival delay 0-0.6s, then cross-fade to the original image over the last 0.4s. Draw as a pure function of progress p so it is seekable.

styles.name: 粒子漩涡
styles.summary: 粒子沿螺旋靠近或远离中心。
styles.prompt: Add a particle vortex at the center of {script}. Place 200 particles by golden angle starting outside a 200px radius and gather them to the center over 6 seconds with power2.in. Angular speed 0.4 rad/s, faster near the center, particle size shrinking from 2.5px to 1.5px near the core. Fade the logo in during the last 0.5 seconds.

styles.name: 流星划过
styles.summary: 细长光迹斜着掠过，像流星一样消失。
styles.prompt: Add three shooting stars to the dark background of {script}. Each is a 100px by 2px white gradient bar traveling x 420px and y 300px at -35 degrees over 1.4 seconds with power1.in, starting at 0.2 seconds and 0.6 seconds apart, opacity rising to 1 then fading to 0. Use fixed start coordinates, no randomness.

styles.name: 烟雾圆环
styles.summary: 烟在环内卷动，外缘轻轻晃动。
styles.prompt: Build a smoke ring background around {script} in WebGL. Ring radius 0.28 UV, thickness 0.08 UV, noise displacement 0.035 UV, speed 0.2/s, 6 seconds. Use two tones, silver white and pale blue, and drive uTime from a timeline tween.

styles.name: 螺旋流场
styles.summary: 连续螺纹从中心向外展开并旋转，像在向内外流动。
styles.prompt: Build a spiral field background behind {script} in WebGL. 4 arms, radial repeat 8, rotate at 25 deg/s for 5 seconds with linear timing, using only navy and teal. Drive the angle from a single GSAP timeline tween.

styles.name: 光束碰撞爆散
styles.summary: 落下的光束碰到地面或边界，瞬间碎成小光片。
styles.prompt: Add a beam collision burst to {script}. A beam falls from y -200 to a floor line at y 900 over 1.5 seconds with power2.in. On impact, 12 fragments fan upward at 220px/s, fall under 500px/s2 gravity for 0.6 seconds, and fade. Fix the angles as an even array and use no randomness.

styles.name: 群鸟聚飞
styles.summary: 小个体保持距离、对齐朝向，像鸟群一样一起转弯。
styles.prompt: Add boid flocking to {script}. Place 120 agents from seed 5 and precompute 360 steps at fixed dt 1/60 with neighbor radius 65px, separation radius 18px, max speed 80px per second, and steering weights alignment 1.0, cohesion 0.8, separation 1.4. Play 6 seconds, drawing each as a 10px triangle facing its heading, with a repulsion steer within 40px of the edges.

styles.name: 分枝生长
styles.summary: 主干分出枝条，小枝继续分叉，结构逐步长开。
styles.prompt: Build a branch growth diagram in <diagram>. Pre-generate SVG paths recursively with a fixed seed at depth 5, length ratio 0.618, and branch angle +/-28 degrees, grouped by depth. Draw each group with stroke-dashoffset over 0.8s with power2.out, each depth starting 0.65s later. Thin the stroke from 8px to 1px by depth. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 细胞自动机
styles.summary: 网格按邻格状态亮灭，图案随之生长或漂移。
styles.prompt: Add a cellular automaton to the background of {script}. Initialize a 60x36 grid (32px cells) with seed 42 and 0.25 occupancy, precompute 42 generations with Conway B3/S23, and play one generation every 120 ms over 5 seconds with a steps ease. Live cells are white at 0.8 opacity and newborn cells teal.

styles.name: 差速星系
styles.summary: 内圈星体比外圈转得快，旋臂随时间卷紧。
styles.prompt: Add a differentially rotating galaxy behind {script}. With WebGL points, scatter 20000 stars (fixed seed) across radius 80-420px on a log spiral, and in the vertex shader mix angular velocity from 2x at the center to 1x at the rim, rotating over 8s linear. Point size 1.5px, additive blending, warm inside and cool outside. Only uProg is driven by a paused timeline.

styles.name: 差异生长
styles.summary: 短线或闭环不断变长起皱，折叠填满空间。
styles.prompt: Add differential line growth to the {script} canvas. Start with a closed loop of 40 nodes, insertion distance 8px, repulsion radius 14px, alignment force 0.2, fixed step 16.67ms, fixed seed, running 7 seconds. Draw a 2px white line on dark navy.

styles.name: 扩散受限生长
styles.summary: 游走点碰到已有团块就黏住，向外长出不规则细枝。
styles.prompt: Add diffusion limited aggregation to the {script} canvas. Start from a center seed with 3000 points, 2px moves and a 2px attach radius. Precompute the attachment order with seed 7, then draw it in order over 7 seconds. Color old points blue and new points white.

styles.name: 伊甸团块生长
styles.summary: 新格子贴到团块外缘，逐渐长成少空隙的圆团。
styles.prompt: Add Eden growth to the {script} canvas. 120x80 grid, starting from 3 seeds, 8 boundary cells attach every 40ms generation, over 5 seconds. Precompute the attachment order with seed 3 and use stepped easing for a generational feel.

styles.name: 电弧
styles.summary: 不规则分叉亮线在点或轮廓间闪现，很快消失。
styles.prompt: Add an electric arc to {script}. Draw three zigzag lightning paths from fixed-seed data as SVG with a 3px white core and blue glow, visible for just 2 frames at 24fps. Two frames later light the word with a text-shadow glow and cool it over 300ms with power2.out. Keep flashes under 3 per second. Use tl.set steps on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 火焰柱
styles.summary: 明亮粒子上升摇摆，在边缘逐渐变淡。
styles.prompt: Add a fire plume beneath {script}. From the anchor (960,900), 90 particles per second rise at 90px per second; over a 0.9-second life the color goes white to orange to black, size shrinks from 22px to 30%, and opacity fades. Lateral sway is a sine of up to 18px, composited with lighter. No randomness; compute position from birth time.

styles.name: 烟花
styles.summary: 升起的光点在空中炸成多股光线，光尾渐渐熄灭。
styles.prompt: Add a single firework to {script}. A rocket rises from y 1000 to y 320 in 0.7 seconds with power2.out, then 80 fragments spread in a circle at 180px per second (70 to 100 percent variation), sag under 120px/s2 gravity, and fade from opacity 1 to 0 over 0.9 seconds. Gold and white only, screen blending. No randomness.

styles.name: 流场粒子
styles.summary: 大量小粒子和尾迹沿看不见的流动曲线前进。
styles.prompt: Build a flow field background for {script}. On a canvas, precompute 480 steps of trajectories for 600 seeded particles along a noise vector field with scale 0.004, and draw them up to step k over 8s. Lines are white at alpha 0.35 with the trailing part fading to alpha 0.08. No state accumulation; draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 分形推进
styles.summary: 持续放大重算的分形，露出重复结构和新细节。
styles.prompt: Apply Fractal Zoom to {script} in <file>. Recompute the fractal in a shader, centered at (-0.7435, 0.1314), with 100 iterations; interpolate zoom logarithmically from 1 to 16 over 6000ms. Use none and a paused GSAP core timeline that produces identical states when seeking backward.

styles.name: 动态网点
styles.summary: 网点大小随亮度改变，整体按波浪或扫描方式移动。
styles.prompt: Build a halftone motion background for {script}. Draw circles on a 12px grid at 45 degrees, with radius set by 60% image brightness and 40% diagonal sine wave, max 5px. Wave length 360px, period 5s looping linearly. Keep dot opacity at or below 0.4 behind text. Draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 融合液球
styles.summary: 圆团靠近时拉出细颈融合，远离时重新分开。
styles.prompt: Make <logo> appear from five merging blobs. In SVG, put five circles (radius 30px) in a group with a goo filter (feGaussianBlur 12px, feColorMatrix alpha 20/-9), gather them to screen center over 2.2s with power2.inOut, staggered by 0.05s. After merging, grow the radius to 70px over 0.6s. Drive from a paused timeline.

styles.name: 多体团簇
styles.summary: 许多点相互吸引，形成小团块和绕行群体。
styles.prompt: Add an N-body orbital cluster to {script}. Place 250 points in a disc distribution from seed 3 and precompute 600 steps into a table with gravity constant 0.8, softening radius 12px and fixed dt of 1/120. Play the index linearly over 5 seconds, drawing points as 2px white at 0.8 opacity, tinting teal as speed increases.

styles.name: 圆形排布收稳
styles.summary: 散圆互相挤开并调整大小，最终排成不重叠布局。
styles.prompt: Create a scene where 40 circles in {script} (radius 18-52px, fixed seed) start overlapped and settle without overlap after 80 relaxation steps. Precompute relax by pushing overlapping circles apart while keeping 4px padding, store as a step array, and play the step index over 4s with power2.out. Draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 粒子聚字
styles.summary: 满屏漂浮粒子飞到一起，组成一个大数字。
styles.prompt: In <file>, build a canvas 2D scene where 900 particles scatter across the frame and then fly in to form {script}. Sample target points once by drawing the text at 560px on an offscreen canvas with a 9px stroke and reading getImageData on a grid. Precompute start points and drift phases with a seeded random, make flight time 0.9s plus up to 1.0s by distance, ease power3.inOut, and bend each path ±0.25 perpendicular to travel. Draw only in draw(p), called from a GSAP proxy tween onUpdate, and hold 0.8s at the end.

styles.name: 粒子力场
styles.summary: 粒子受吸引、排斥和旋转力影响，绕中心留下曲线。
styles.prompt: Build a particle force field for {script}. Precompute 360 steps at fixed dt 1/60 and damping 0.98 for 300 seeded particles under 3 force points (two attractors, one repeller, one with a rotation component), store the trajectories, and play them over 6s linear with trails at alpha 0.3. Draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 粒子喷泉
styles.summary: 粒子从地面窄口喷起，再沿抛物线落下。
styles.prompt: Add a particle fountain at the bottom center (960,1000) of {script}. Particles are born 50 per second and shoot upward at 240px per second within 24 degrees, spreading angles by a golden-ratio sweep, arc under 400px/s2 gravity, and vanish after 2.4 seconds. Play 5 seconds and compute positions directly from t and birth time.

styles.name: 粒子生命
styles.summary: 不同颜色粒子互相吸引排斥，组成团块或彼此追逐。
styles.prompt: Add a particle life simulation to the {script} canvas. 600 particles, 4 colors, interaction radius 80px, damping 0.9, fixed step 16.67ms, 8 seconds. Hardcode a seeded force matrix in the range -1 to 1 as constants and draw each particle as a 4px circle.

styles.name: 粒子网络
styles.summary: 邻近移动点用线相连，距离拉开后连线消失。
styles.prompt: Add a connected particle network to the background of {script}. 100 points fixed by seed 9 drift in set directions at 12px per second and wrap to the opposite side when they leave. Join points within 120px by lines whose opacity is 0.35*(1-d/120), point radius 2px, 6-second loop.

styles.name: 黏菌网络
styles.summary: 个体沿前者留下的轨迹前进，保留路径加粗成网。
styles.prompt: Build a physarum network simulation behind {script} in WebGL. 10000 agents, sensor distance 8px, sensor angle 30 degrees, trail decay 0.97 per step, fixed step 16.67ms, fixed seed, 8 seconds. Map trails from teal to white on a dark background.

styles.name: 雨线
styles.summary: 细线沿一个方向快速落下，在地面留下小印迹。
styles.prompt: Add rain streaks to the background of {script}. 180 streaks fall at 350 to 590px per second (5 speed steps) tilted 12 degrees, length 12 to 27px in 4 steps, color #bcd4ff at 0.35 opacity. Compute position as (offset + speed*t) mod 1200 so a 4-second loop closes, and let 8px-radius rings spread for 0.3 seconds near y 1020.

styles.name: 随机游走
styles.summary: 点不断随机迈出短步，留下不规则轨迹。
styles.prompt: Add a random walk to {script}. 80 dots start at the center (960,540) and walk 240 steps over 4 seconds, each step adding a uniform random -2.6 to 2.6px (about 1.5px standard deviation) to x and y. Precompute with a seed-42 LCG into a table and leave trails as lines at 0.18 opacity. Do not use Math.random.

styles.name: 反应扩散
styles.summary: 小斑块扩散分裂，逐渐形成条纹或迷宫图案。
styles.prompt: Add a Gray-Scott reaction diffusion growth behind {script}. Grid 256x144, fixed step 16.67ms, diffusion A 1.0 and B 0.5, feed 0.055, kill 0.062, seeded from 3 spots, 8 seconds. Fix randomness with a seed and make each frame depend only on the step count.

styles.name: 刚体连锁落下
styles.summary: 许多球或方块受重力落下，碰撞反弹后堆在地面。
styles.prompt: Add a rigid-body cascade to {script}. Place 30 circles of radius 12px above the frame from fixed seed 7 and let them fall for 4 seconds with gravity 600px/s2 and restitution 0.6, colliding with the floor and each other. Precompute at a fixed 1/60 s step into a frame table and let the timeline only play back the index. Replace Math.random with a seeded PRNG.

styles.name: 上升气泡
styles.summary: 半透明圆从下方升起，摇摆变大后淡去。
styles.prompt: Add rising bubbles to the background of {script}. Eight translucent circles per second rise at 35px per second or more, grow from radius 4px to 18px over 3.5 seconds, and sway up to 14px sideways as a sine. Use a 1px white stroke at 0.6 opacity and fade out over the last 0.5 seconds. x positions come from the formula (i*211)%1500; no randomness.

styles.name: 烟柱
styles.summary: 柔软团块升起、长大并重叠，逐渐稀释成烟。
styles.prompt: Add a smoke plume above {script}. From the anchor (960,900), 20 gray (#9aa3b2) circles per second rise at 25px per second and drift sideways at 14px per second. Size grows from 12px to 70px and opacity fades from 0.25 to 0 over 2.6 seconds, fading in over the first 0.25 seconds. Play 5 seconds, starting 2 seconds pre-warmed.

styles.name: 火花喷射
styles.summary: 小亮点向外飞散，拖出短尾后熄灭。
styles.prompt: Add a spark spray at the collision point of {script} with GSAP and canvas. Build 60 particles from a seed-11 random with random angle, initial speed 250 to 450px/s and life 0.38 to 0.52s. Write draw(t) as a pure function of time, computing position as v*t*(1 - t/life*0.5), and draw with lighter blending. Start at 0.4s on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 奇异吸引子
styles.summary: 大量点沿复杂空间轨道循环，画出环和交叠条带。
styles.prompt: Add strange attractor trails to {script}. Integrate 20000 points of the Lorenz system (sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3) at a fixed dt of 1/128 from a seeded initial distribution, play for 6 seconds, and rotate the camera around the y axis at 20 degrees per second. Draw each point's last 24 steps as a tail from alpha 0.15 to 0, mapping color from teal to magenta by speed.

styles.name: 触须波动
styles.summary: 细触须从中心伸出，错开节奏弯曲和伸直。
styles.prompt: Add a tendril wave behind {script}. From the center (960,540), 36 tendrils spread at equal angles, length 140px with 8 segments. Each segment bends by sin(t + phase - segment*0.4), up to 20 degrees at the tip, neighbor phase difference 2π*3/36, repeating every 2.2 seconds. Stroke tapers from 3px to 1px in #7dd3fc at 0.8 opacity.

styles.name: 泰森多边形运动
styles.summary: 不规则小格和裂缝纹路流动，大小形状持续变化。
styles.prompt: Add an animated Voronoi to the background of {script}. On a grid with an average cell diameter of 48px, hash a seed point per cell and orbit it at 0.35 cell radius by phase t in a 4-second loop. Draw borders as F2-F1 white 1.5px lines at 0.3 opacity, with cell interiors shading softly from dark navy.

styles.name: 波干涉
styles.summary: 网格点按不同相位起伏，形成亮节点和空白区。
styles.prompt: Build a wave interference grid for {script}. On a canvas, lay 30x30 dots at 48x32px spacing and displace each by v*4px where v = sin(i*0.84+phase) + sin(j*1.26-phase) (a 2:3 frequency ratio), with radius 3.5+v*1.2px. Loop phase from 0 to 2pi over 6s, linear. Draw as a pure function of progress so it is seekable.

styles.name: 粒子填字
styles.summary: 字形内部的小点持续移动，整体仍组成笔画。
styles.prompt: Make the title in {script} a particle-filled text. Draw the text to a canvas to build an alpha mask, then place 2px-radius dots in every 6px cell inside the mask. Dots orbit on a 1.8s cycle with phase seeded from the cell index. Cap at 4000 dots.

styles.name: 地球连接弧线
styles.summary: 地球缓慢转动，地点之间陆续出现弧形连线。
styles.prompt: Implement Rotating Globe Connections for {script} in <file>. A globe rotates slowly as connection arcs appear between geographic locations. Use rotation period: 12000ms; arc reveal duration: 1500ms; location count: 30; arc spacing: 500ms; easing: none in a single paused GSAP core timeline that supports seeking. Do not imply distance or volume through arc height or brightness.

styles.name: 卡片翻面
styles.summary: 卡片绕横轴或竖轴转半圈，正反面互换。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to flip {script} 180 degrees around the Y axis. Give the parent perspective 900px and the card transform-style preserve-3d, with both faces stacked and backface-visibility hidden. Start at 0.5 seconds, rotate for 0.8 seconds with power2.inOut, then hold the back for 1.2 seconds. Use transforms only and one paused timeline so it can be seeked.

styles.name: 纵深拼合
styles.summary: 空间里歪斜旋转的元素依次聚到平面上的准确位置。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to build a scene where {script} elements gather into place in 3D. Fix start values with a seeded function: z +/-300px, rotationX +/-30 degrees, rotationY +/-70 degrees, opacity 0. Starting at 0.2 seconds, each element arrives over 1.0 second with power3.out at 50ms intervals, then holds 0.6 seconds. No Math.random, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 物体转台
styles.summary: 产品绕固定轴旋转，依次展示正面、侧面和背面。
styles.prompt: Use Three.js to make <model> turn a full revolution around the y axis in 6 seconds. Keep the camera fixed at 15 degrees elevation. Rotate at constant speed with ease none for the first 5.2 seconds, then decelerate with power3.out for the last 0.8 seconds to stop facing front. Drive rotation from a GSAP timeline so it is seekable.

styles.name: 传送门显现
styles.summary: 发光开口出现，主体穿过边缘走向观众。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to make {script} emerge from a portal. At 0 seconds open a circular clip-path from radius 0 to 300px over 0.7 seconds with power3.out. From 0.3 seconds bring the subject from z -300, scale 0.6 to z 0, scale 1 over 0.9 seconds. Fade the rim glow up from 0.1 seconds and back down over 0.4 seconds. One paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 文字挤出
styles.summary: 相同字形沿纵深堆叠，稍作旋转露出厚侧面。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to extrude the {script} headline. Clone the text into 8 layers, darker toward the back. Starting at 0.3 seconds, spread each layer -2px in z over 1.2 seconds while rotating the group rotationY 18 degrees. Parent perspective 900px, preserve-3d, ease power3.out. Keep the top layer as the readable front and hold 0.8 seconds.

styles.name: 小片翻字
styles.summary: 标题上的小片像波浪一样翻转，露出背面的文字。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to split {script} into a 12x6 tile grid and flip it to a new phrase. Each tile rotates 180 degrees on X over 0.6 seconds with power2.inOut, delayed by (col+row)*25ms plus 0.3 seconds. Front and back faces overlap with backface-visibility hidden, the back showing the new phrase on the same background. Finish within 1.5 seconds on a paused timeline.

styles.name: 波浪轮播
styles.summary: 方盒沿波浪轨道前进，轮流来到最前方。
styles.prompt: Build a wave carousel in WebGL or CSS 3D with <8 items> mapped to 8 boxes. Period 6 seconds linear, amplitude 80px, 45-degree phase step per index, and the front box at rotationY 0 so its text is readable. Compute positions as a pure function of progress and use one paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 动态灯光
styles.summary: 三维物体上的光色和强度变化，轮流照亮不同部位。
styles.prompt: Use Three.js and GSAP to animate the lighting on <model>. From 0.3 seconds over 1.6 seconds with power2.inOut, raise light intensity from 0 to 3, lerp the color from #4aa3ff to #ff9a3c in RGB, and move the light x from -2 to 2. Keep intensity at or below 3, updating values in the onUpdate of an object tween on a paused, seekable timeline.

styles.name: 雾中纵深
styles.summary: 远物在雾中模糊变淡，靠近时逐渐清楚。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to add atmospheric depth to three background layers of {script}. Start the farthest at opacity 0.3, blur 3px and the middle at opacity 0.65, blur 1.5px, and over 3 seconds bring all to opacity 1, blur 0 with sine.inOut. Each layer starts 0.4 seconds later; the nearest is sharp from the beginning. No blur on text layers.

styles.name: 镜头穿层
styles.summary: 镜头飞过间隔排列的平面，最后停在关键词上。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Use perspective 1,200px and preserve-3d. Space seven planes 900px apart from Z 0 to −5,400px, move the world from −300px to 5,400px in 3.3 seconds with sine.inOut, and fade each near plane at relative Z 100 to 650px. Hold the final keyword for 0.5 seconds. Use paper, ink, a single scarlet focus, large numerals and serif text in one seekable GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 纸卡翻堆
styles.summary: 重叠纸页依次翻过，堆到正面最终卡片后面。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Use perspective 1400px and five paper sheets separated by 65px in z. Flip four sheets to rotateX -115deg for 0.65s starting at 0.38+i*0.18s, then stack them at z -420-i*55px and rotateX -22deg over 0.75s. Bring the vermilion 05 sheet to the front over 1.1s and hold from 3.3s. Use paper, ink and one vermilion focus with a single paused GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 四角透视
styles.summary: 平面四个角移动，让图像倾成透视形状。
styles.prompt: Add a corner pin to the image in {script}. Over 0.8 seconds move the corners (0,0) to (40,30), (1920,0) to (1880,-20), (1920,1080) to (1900,1050), (0,1080) to (20,1080) with power2.inOut, forming a perspective trapezoid. Compute it as a matrix3d homography.

styles.name: 封面流
styles.summary: 卡片沿弧形队列移动，中央大而正，侧面小而斜。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to lay out <7 cards> as a coverflow and animate a one-step shift. Parent perspective 900px, the center card faces front at scale 1, side cards rotateY +/-45 degrees, z -160px and 0.1 less scale per step of distance. At 0.5 seconds move all cards one slot left over 0.6 seconds with power2.inOut and recompute z-index by distance from center.

styles.name: 深层视差
styles.summary: 镜头横移，多层版面以不同速度运动显示纵深。
styles.prompt: Apply this effect to {script}. Move the world 600px with seven layer ratios of 0.1, 0.25, 0.45, 0.7, 0.95, 1.3 and 1.8. Start at 0.3s, animate for 3s using sine.inOut, blur foreground text by 2px and hold for 0.7s. Use paper, ink and one vermilion focus with a single paused GSAP timeline.

styles.name: 纵深卡片掠过
styles.summary: 叠卡依次向前滚动，经过的卡片向镜头翻落。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to make <5 cards> sit stacked in depth and pass toward the camera one by one. Parent perspective 1000px, cards spaced 260px apart in z. Starting at 0, 1.4, 2.6, 3.6 and 4.3 seconds, the front card flies to z 600, rotationY 40, opacity 0 over 0.9 seconds with power3.in while the rest advance one slot. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 动态倒影
styles.summary: 周围物体或光源移动，镜面里的倒影跟着变化。
styles.prompt: Add dynamic reflection to the sphere in {script}. Use a cubemap reflection at 256px with roughness 0.1, rotate the sphere at 30 deg/s for 5 seconds while a bright panel moves along the x axis around it. Update the cube camera every frame so the panel moves inside the reflection.

styles.name: 拆解组装
styles.summary: 产品零件沿轴分开露出内部结构，再聚回整体。
styles.prompt: Show the 5 parts of the product model in {script} as an exploded view. Spread them along the y axis with 80px spacing around the center part over 0.9 seconds with a 0.1s stagger between parts. Turn labels on while spread, and from 1.8 seconds reassemble in reverse order over 0.9 seconds with power2.inOut.

styles.name: 硬阴影弹出
styles.summary: 元素斜向轻移，后方长出分层硬边阴影。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to add a hard shadow pop to {script}. From 0.3 seconds over 0.4 seconds, move the element 8px to the upper left while growing a solid #111 text-shadow in 1px steps from 0 to 8 layers toward the lower right. Round the step count in onUpdate, ease power2.out, one paused timeline.

styles.name: 图片展开
styles.summary: 卷起的图面缓缓展开，最后平铺成图片。
styles.prompt: Use WebGL and GSAP to unroll <image>. Split a plane into 60 segments and wrap the vertices right of an edge around a cylinder of radius 80px. From 0.3 seconds over 1.4 seconds with power2.out, tween radius 80 to 0 and edge 1 to 0. At the end curvature and shadow are exactly 0. Update uniforms so the paused timeline can seek.

styles.name: 图层分离
styles.summary: 叠放平面向不同深度和角度散开，再合回去。
styles.prompt: Show the screen stack in {script} with layer separation. On the container set perspective 1400, rotateX 55 and rotateZ -35, then spread the 4 layers' translateZ to 0, 100, 200, 300px over 0.8 seconds from 0.3s with a 60ms stagger and power3.inOut, and merge them back to 0 in order at 1.8 seconds.

styles.name: 噪声软球
styles.summary: 球面不均匀地鼓起扭转，形状持续变化。
styles.prompt: Turn the sphere object in {script} into a noise blob. In the WebGL vertex shader apply normal-direction noise displacement of 0.18 radius at frequency 2.5 and a 20 degree twist about the y axis, driving uTime from 0 to 1.5 over 5 seconds with ease none. Use a soft gradient material.

styles.name: 揉纸展开
styles.summary: 平纸沿多道折痕缩成小球，再重新打开。
styles.prompt: Use WebGL and GSAP to crumple and unfold <paper image>. Fold a plane mesh along 6 seeded crease axes and recompute normals so lighting shows. From 0.6 seconds over 0.55 seconds with power3.in raise strength from 0 to 0.85; from 1.5 seconds over 0.4 seconds with power2.out return it to 0. After restoring it must match the flat plane. No Math.random.

styles.name: 透视拉平
styles.summary: 小而倾斜的屏幕转向正面，同时逐渐放大。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to flatten <screen image> into view. Parent perspective 1200px; start at rotationX 30 degrees, scale 0.85, transformOrigin bottom center, and from 0.3 seconds over 1.5 seconds go to rotationX 0, scale 1 with power2.inOut. The final frame ends exactly at zero rotation. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 透视网格前流
styles.summary: 汇向地平线的网格向观众方向流动。
styles.prompt: Use CSS and GSAP to make a perspective grid drift behind {script}. Tilt a 40px grid background with rotateX 65 degrees and perspective 800px, and move backgroundPositionY from 0 to 40px over 4 seconds with ease none. Cyan lines at opacity 0.35, fade near the horizon, and loop by an integer multiple of the grid spacing.

styles.name: 透视面板旋转
styles.summary: 不同颜色长板绕中轴扇形转开，近处面显得更大。
styles.prompt: Build a perspective panel rotation backdrop behind {script} in WebGL. Place 7 panels around a central axis 25 degrees apart with a 15 degree tilt, rotating at 18 deg/s for 5 seconds with linear timing. Alternate two brand colors and add a faint edge light.

styles.name: 立体书
styles.summary: 书页打开，折叠纸结构随之立起组成场景。
styles.prompt: Add a pop-up book reveal to the intro of {script}. Set container perspective 1600px, open the right page from 0.3 seconds with rotateY -110 degrees over 1s using power2.inOut, and from 0.9 seconds raise 3 paper structures to rotateX -80 degrees with a 0.12s stagger. Give every face a soft shadow.

styles.name: 屏幕内容涌出
styles.summary: 倾斜设备屏幕转正，里面内容放大超出边框。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to open <device mockup> and enlarge {script}. Parent perspective 1400px; from 0.3 seconds over 1.0 second rotate the lid rotationX 80 to 0 (power3.inOut), and from 1.1 seconds over 0.8 seconds scale the content 0.8 to 1.5 (power2.inOut). The scale must not start before the opening finishes. Paused timeline.

styles.name: 阴影高度
styles.summary: 物体离地升起时，阴影变宽变淡，显示悬浮高度。
styles.prompt: Use GSAP to lift <card> 24px starting at 0.4 seconds over 0.6 seconds while widening and lightening its shadow. Tween boxShadow with fromTo from 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.30) to 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), ease power2.out. The shadow must not get darker. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 球面化
styles.summary: 平面图像中央鼓起，像包在球面上。
styles.prompt: Add spherize to the image in {script} in WebGL. From 0.3 seconds raise strength from 0 to 0.7 over 0.9 seconds with power2.inOut, distorting UVs with a spherical mapping that bulges the center. Outside the edge is transparent over a dark flat background.

styles.name: 星空跃迁
styles.summary: 星点从中心向外透视散开，拉成长长的光线。
styles.prompt: Use Canvas and GSAP to build a starfield warp behind {script}. Place 300 stars with an index-based seeded function and accelerate to 600px/s over 2.5 seconds with power3.in. Draw each star as a line from previous to current position for streaks, and decelerate back to points over the last 0.5 seconds. No Math.random; draw as a pure function of progress v so it is seekable.

styles.name: 立体字翻起
styles.summary: 平躺文字绕横轴或竖轴立起来，露出正面。
styles.prompt: Stand up the title letters in {script}. Put perspective 1000px on the parent; each glyph goes rotationX -90 to 0 and opacity 0 to 1 over 0.55s power3.out with a bottom hinge (transform-origin 50% 100%), staggered 0.04s. Split Korean by syllable.

styles.name: 曲面文字
styles.summary: 短语绕圆柱或圆环排列旋转，正面的词不断更换。
styles.prompt: Arrange the phrases <items> of {script} on a 12-face cylinder. Each face gets rotationY i*30 degrees, translateZ 180px, backface-visibility hidden, with a parent perspective of 1000px. Rotate the parent to rotationY -360 over 10 seconds at constant speed, with front phrases at opacity 1 and back ones at 0.25.

styles.name: 行走循环
styles.summary: 角色手脚交替摆动，循环走路。
styles.prompt: Implement Walk Cycle on {script}. Use period 1.2s; stride 0.5 units; left-right phase offset 180deg; joint rotation amplitude 25deg; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 弧线加载
styles.summary: 旋转圆弧交替变长和变短。
styles.prompt: Apply Arc Spinner to {script} in <file>. Use a 3s segment with none; implement these explicit settings: Rotation period: 1s, Arc length period: 1.5s, Arc length: 12~72%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 呼吸循环
styles.summary: 静止元素反复小幅改变大小和位置。
styles.prompt: Apply Breathing Loop to {script} in <file>. Use a 2.4s segment with sine.inOut; implement these explicit settings: Scale amplitude: 0.012, Vertical amplitude: 2px. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 轻浮循环
styles.summary: 元素轻轻上下起伏。
styles.prompt: Apply Float Loop to {script} in <file>. Use a 2.4s segment with sine.inOut; implement these explicit settings: Float height: 12px, Phase offset: 0s. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 不定进度条
styles.summary: 亮条反复扫过裁切的轨道。
styles.prompt: Apply Indeterminate Progress to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.5s segment with sine.inOut; implement these explicit settings: Bar width: 20~60%, Track travel: 100%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 加载圆点
styles.summary: 几个点错开节奏弹跳或放大缩小。
styles.prompt: Apply Loading Dots to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.2s segment with sine.inOut; implement these explicit settings: Dot count: 3, Dot delay: 0.15s, Jump height: 8px. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 跑马灯
styles.summary: 重复内容连续穿过可见窗口。
styles.prompt: Apply Marquee to {script} in <file>. Use a 12s segment with none; implement these explicit settings: Speed: 80px/s, Item gap: 24px, Strip copies: 2. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 扩散圆环
styles.summary: 同心圆从同一中心向外扩大并淡去。
styles.prompt: Apply Ripple Rings to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.6s segment with power2.out; implement these explicit settings: Ring count: 3, Ring delay: 0.4s, Scale range: 0.2~1.5. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 骨架闪光
styles.summary: 亮带扫过暗淡的内容占位块。
styles.prompt: Apply Skeleton Shimmer to {script} in <file>. Implement the provided keyframes with 1800ms duration, band width 25%, band opacity 0.2, easing linear. Repeat every 1800ms and stop when loading finishes.

styles.name: 自转循环
styles.summary: 齿轮、指针或加载图标绕固定中心转动。
styles.prompt: Apply Spin Loop to {script} in <file>. Use a 2.4s segment with none; implement these explicit settings: Rotation per cycle: 360deg, Transform origin: 50% 50%. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 描边追光
styles.summary: 一小段亮线沿轮廓不断游走。
styles.prompt: Apply Stroke Chase to {script} in <file>. Use a 1.8s segment with none; implement these explicit settings: Visible path segment: 18%, Stroke width: 3px. Use a paused, seekable timeline and repeat through local timeline time.

styles.name: 不规则抖动
styles.summary: 位置或角度持续小幅不规则变化。
styles.prompt: Add a wiggle to {script} with GSAP. Using a fixed-seed random (seed 7), from 0.2s every 0.5s move to a new target within +/-12px in x and y and +/-3 degrees rotation with sine.inOut, and return to 0 at 2.2s. No Math.random. One paused timeline.

styles.name: 氛围光晕
styles.summary: 模糊彩光在表面后方移动并变亮。
styles.prompt: Apply Ambient Glow to {script}. Use a 5-second cycle, 48px blur, opacity from 0.5 to 1, and 24px light travel, and ease-in-out easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 环境粒子漂移
styles.summary: 细小暗淡的粒子以不同速度飘动。
styles.prompt: Implement Ambient Particle Drift on {script}. Use period 8s; particle count 70; size 1~4px; speed 5~18px/s; opacity 0.25; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 柱状波浪加载
styles.summary: 相邻柱条错峰升降，组成波浪。
styles.prompt: Apply Bar Wave Loader to {script}. Use a 1.2-second cycle, five bars, 100ms offsets, and scaleY from 0.4 to 1, and ease-in-out easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 追逐圆点
styles.summary: 多个点一起绕行，并错峰改变大小。
styles.prompt: Apply Chasing Dots to {script}. Use a 2-second cycle, six dots with 120ms phase offsets, and ease-in-out easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 吃豆加载
styles.summary: 圆形角色张嘴，一列小点不断移进嘴里。
styles.prompt: Apply Chomp Loader to {script}. Use a 1-second cycle, a 60 degree mouth opening and 20px dot spacing, and linear easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 环形点波
styles.summary: 围成圆圈的小点依次亮起。
styles.prompt: Apply Circular Dot Wave to {script}. Use a 1.2-second cycle, 12 dots with 100ms offsets, and linear easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 颜色循环
styles.summary: 表面在少量颜色之间缓慢循环。
styles.prompt: Apply Color Cycle to {script}. Use a 6-second cycle, four colors at similar lightness, and ease-in-out easing. Include the required element structure and drive the effect with one paused, seekable timeline. Hold the first frame when reduced motion is enabled.

styles.name: 能量光球
styles.summary: 发光球轻微变形，光线在内部流转。
styles.prompt: Implement Energy Orb on {script}. Use period 5s; radius 120px; deformation 10%; flow speed 0.25; use none easing. Drive the effect with a paused GSAP timeline and absolute time, and reproduce the same state on every seek without Math.random. Keep foreground text readable.

styles.name: 萤火闪烁
